<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation">Hyperswitch - API Documentation v0.1.0</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.


## Get started

Hyperswitch provides a collection of APIs that enable you to process and manage payments.
Our APIs accept and return JSON in the HTTP body, and return standard HTTP response codes.

You can consume the APIs directly using your favorite HTTP/REST library.

We have a testing environment referred to "sandbox", which you can setup to test API calls without
affecting production data.
Currently, our sandbox environment is live while our production environment is under development
and will be available soon.
You can sign up on our Dashboard to get API keys to access Hyperswitch API.

### Environment

Use the following base URLs when making requests to the APIs:

| Environment   |  Base URL                          |
|---------------|------------------------------------|
| Sandbox       | <https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io>   |
| Production    | <https://api.hyperswitch.io>       |

## Authentication

When you sign up on our [dashboard](https://app.hyperswitch.io) and create a merchant
account, you are given a secret key (also referred as api-key) and a publishable key.
You may authenticate all API requests with Hyperswitch server by providing the appropriate key in
the request Authorization header.

| Key             |  Description                                                                                  |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| api-key         | Private key. Used to authenticate all API requests from your merchant server                  |
| publishable key | Unique identifier for your account. Used to authenticate API requests from your app's client  |

Never share your secret api keys. Keep them guarded and secure.

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io">https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io</a> - Sandbox Environment

Email: <a href="mailto:support.global@juspay.io">Hyperswitch Support</a> 
Web: <a href="https://hyperswitch.io">Hyperswitch Support</a> 
License: Apache-2.0

# Authentication

* API Key (admin_api_key)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. Format: `admin-api-key=<admin-api-key>`

Admin API keys allow you to perform some privileged actions such as creating a merchant account and Merchant Connector account.

* API Key (api_key)
    - Parameter Name: **api-key**, in: header. Use the API key created under your merchant account from the HyperSwitch dashboard. API key is used to authenticate API requests from your merchant server only. Don't expose this key on a website or embed it in a mobile application.

* API Key (ephemeral_key)
    - Parameter Name: **api-key**, in: header. Ephemeral keys provide temporary access to singular data, such as access to a single customer object for a short period of time.

- HTTP Authentication, scheme: bearer

* API Key (publishable_key)
    - Parameter Name: **api-key**, in: header. Publishable keys are a type of keys that can be public and have limited scope of usage.

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-merchant-account">Merchant Account</h1>

Create and manage merchant accounts

## Merchant Account - Create

<a id="opIdCreate a Merchant Account"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/accounts \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "merchant_id": "merchant_abc"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts`

Create a new account for a *merchant* and the *merchant* could be a seller or retailer or client who likes to receive and send payments.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "merchant_id": "merchant_abc"
}
```

## Merchant Account - Update

<a id="opIdUpdate a Merchant Account"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/accounts/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "merchant_id": "merchant_abc",
    "merchant_name": "merchant_name"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}`

Updates details of an existing merchant account. Helpful in updating merchant details such as email, contact details, or other configuration details like webhook, routing algorithm etc

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "merchant_id": "merchant_abc",
  "merchant_name": "merchant_name"
}
```

## Merchant Account - KV Status

<a id="opIdEnable/Disable KV for a Merchant Account"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/accounts/string/kv \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "kv_enabled": "false"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{account_id}/kv`

Toggle KV mode for the Merchant Account

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "kv_enabled": "false"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

```json
  "kv_enabled": true
}
```

## Profile - Create

<a id="opIdCreate A Profile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/account/string/business_profile \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{}'
```

`POST /account/{account_id}/business_profile`

Creates a new *profile* for a merchant

> Body parameter

```json
{}
```

<h3 id="profile---create-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Profile Created|[ProfileResponse](#schemaprofileresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid data|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key
</aside>

## Profile - Retrieve

<a id="opIdRetrieve a Profile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/account/string/business_profile/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /account/{account_id}/business_profile/{profile_id}`

Retrieve existing *profile*

<h3 id="profile---retrieve-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the merchant account|
|profile_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the profile|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key
</aside>

## Profile - Update

<a id="opIdUpdate a Profile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/account/string/business_profile/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "profile_name": "shoe_business"
  }'
```

`POST /account/{account_id}/business_profile/{profile_id}`

Update the *profile*

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "profile_name": "shoe_business"
}
```

## Merchant Connector - Create

<a id="opIdCreate a Merchant Connector"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/account/string/connectors \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "connector_account_details": {
      "api_key": "{{adyen-api-key}}",
      "auth_type": "BodyKey",
      "key1": "{{adyen_merchant_account}}"
    },
    "connector_label": "EU_adyen",
    "connector_name": "adyen",
    "connector_type": "payment_processor"
  }'
```

`POST /account/{account_id}/connectors`

Creates a new Merchant Connector for the merchant account. The connector could be a payment processor/facilitator/acquirer or a provider of specialized services like Fraud/Accounting etc.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "connector_account_details": {
    "api_key": "{{adyen-api-key}}",
    "auth_type": "BodyKey",
    "key1": "{{adyen_merchant_account}}"
  },
  "connector_label": "EU_adyen",
  "connector_name": "adyen",
  "connector_type": "payment_processor"
}
```

<h3 id="merchant-connector---create-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the merchant account|
|body|body|[MerchantConnectorCreate](#schemamerchantconnectorcreate)|true|none|
|» connector_type|body|[ConnectorType](#schemaconnectortype)|true|Type of the Connector for the financial use case. Could range from Payments to Accounting to Banking.|
|» connector_name|body|[Connector](#schemaconnector)|true|none|
|» connector_label|body|string \| null|false|This is an unique label you can generate and pass in order to identify this connector account on your Hyperswitch dashboard and reports. Eg: if your profile label is `default`, connector label can be `stripe_default`|
|» profile_id|body|string \| null|false|Identifier for the profile, if not provided default will be chosen from merchant account|
|» connector_account_details|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » connector_account_details|body|object \| null|false|Account details of the Connector. You can specify up to 50 keys, with key names up to 40 characters long and values up to 500 characters long. Useful for storing additional, structured information on an object.|
|» » metadata|body|object \| null|false|Metadata is useful for storing additional, unstructured information on an object.|
|» payment_methods_enabled|body|[[PaymentMethodsEnabled](#schemapaymentmethodsenabled)]|false|An object containing the details about the payment methods that need to be enabled under this merchant connector account|
|» connector_webhook_details|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » merchant_secret|body|string|true|none|
|» » additional_secret|body|string|true|none|
|» metadata|body|object \| null|false|Metadata is useful for storing additional, unstructured information on an object.|
|» test_mode|body|boolean \| null|false|A boolean value to indicate if the connector is in Test mode. By default, its value is false.|
|» disabled|body|boolean \| null|false|A boolean value to indicate if the connector is disabled. By default, its value is false.|
|» frm_configs|body|[[FrmConfigs](#schemafrmconfigs)]|false|Contains the frm configs for the merchant connector|
|» business_country|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» business_label|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** The business label to which the connector account is attached. To be deprecated soon. Use the 'profile_id' instead|
|» business_sub_label|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** The business sublabel to which the connector account is attached. To be deprecated soon. Use the 'profile_id' instead|
|» merchant_connector_id|body|string \| null|false|Unique ID of the connector|
|» pm_auth_config|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» status|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» additional_merchant_data|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » open_banking_recipient_data|body|[MerchantRecipientData](#schemamerchantrecipientdata)|true|none|
|» connector_wallets_details|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » apple_pay_combined|body|object \| null|false|This field contains the Apple Pay certificates and credentials for iOS and Web Apple Pay flow|
|» » apple_pay|body|object \| null|false|This field is for our legacy Apple Pay flow that contains the Apple Pay certificates and credentials for only iOS Apple Pay flow|
|» » amazon_pay|body|object \| null|false|This field contains the Amazon Pay certificates and credentials|
|» » samsung_pay|body|object \| null|false|This field contains the Samsung Pay certificates and credentials|
|» » paze|body|object \| null|false|This field contains the Paze certificates and credentials|
|» » google_pay|body|object \| null|false|This field contains the Google Pay certificates and credentials|

## Merchant Connector - Update

<a id="opIdUpdate a Merchant Connector"></a>

> Code samples


<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-payments">Payments</h1>

Create and manage one-time payments, recurring payments and mandates

## Payments - Create

<a id="opIdCreate a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 6540,
    "currency": "USD"
  }'
```

`POST /payments`

Creates a payment resource, which represents a customer's intent to pay.
This endpoint is the starting point for various payment flows:


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amount": 6540,
  "currency": "USD"
}
```

<h3 id="payments---create-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Integration-Type|header|string \| null|false|Selects the response shape. `server` returns the payment together with `payment_method_list` and `session_tokens`, so a server-to-server integration can render its checkout from one call; it is honoured only with merchant API key authentication. `client`, or no header, returns the payment response unchanged.|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|
|body|body|[PaymentsCreateRequest](#schemapaymentscreaterequest)|true|none|
|» amount|body|integer(int64)|true|The primary amount for the payment, provided in the lowest denomination of the specified currency (e.g., 6540 for $65.40 USD). This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|» order_tax_amount|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Total tax amount applicable to the order, in the lowest denomination of the currency.|
|» currency|body|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "USD", "EUR") for the payment amount. This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|» amount_to_capture|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|The amount to be captured from the user's payment method, in the lowest denomination. If not provided, and `capture_method` is `automatic`, the full payment `amount` will be captured. If `capture_method` is `manual`, this can be specified in the `/capture` call. Must be less than or equal to the authorized amount.|
|» shipping_cost|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|The shipping cost for the payment. This is required for tax calculation in some regions.|
|» payment_id|body|string \| null|false|Optional. A merchant-provided unique identifier for the payment, contains 30 characters long (e.g., "pay_mbabizu24mvu3mela5njyhpit4"). If provided, it ensures idempotency for the payment creation request. If omitted, Hyperswitch generates a unique ID for the payment.|
|» routing|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » data|body|[RoutableConnectorChoice](#schemaroutableconnectorchoice)|true|Routable Connector chosen for a payment|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » data|body|[[RoutableConnectorChoice](#schemaroutableconnectorchoice)]|true|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » data|body|[[ConnectorVolumeSplit](#schemaconnectorvolumesplit)]|true|none|
|» connector|body|[[Connector](#schemaconnector)]|false|This allows to manually select a connector with which the payment can go through.|
|» capture_method|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» authentication_type|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» billing|body|object \| null|false|none|

<h3 id="payments---create-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Payment created|[PaymentsCreateResponseOpenApi](#schemapaymentscreateresponseopenapi)|
|400|Bad Request|Missing Mandatory fields|[GenericErrorResponseOpenApi](#schemagenericerrorresponseopenapi)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key
</aside>

## Payments - Retrieve

<a id="opIdRetrieve a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /payments/{payment_id}`

Retrieves a Payment. This API can also be used to get the status of a previously initiated payment or next action for an ongoing payment

<h3 id="payments---retrieve-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|path|string|true|The identifier for payment|
|force_sync|query|boolean \| null|false|Decider to enable or disable the connector call for retrieve request|
|client_secret|query|string \| null|false|This is a token which expires after 15 minutes, used from the client to authenticate and create sessions from the SDK|
|expand_attempts|query|boolean \| null|false|If enabled provides list of attempts linked to payment intent|
|expand_captures|query|boolean \| null|false|If enabled provides list of captures linked to latest attempt|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|

<h3 id="payments---retrieve-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Gets the payment with final status|[PaymentsResponse](#schemapaymentsresponse)|
|404|Not Found|No payment found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key, publishable_key
</aside>

## Payments - Update

<a id="opIdUpdate a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 7654
  }'
```

`POST /payments/{payment_id}`

To update the properties of a *PaymentIntent* object. This may include attaching a payment method, or attaching customer object or metadata fields after the Payment is created

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amount": 7654
}
```

<h3 id="payments---update-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|path|string|true|The identifier for payment|
|X-Integration-Type|header|string \| null|false|Selects the response shape. `server` returns the payment together with `payment_method_list` and `session_tokens`, so a server-to-server integration can render its checkout from one call; it is honoured only with merchant API key authentication. `client`, or no header, returns the payment response unchanged.|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|
|body|body|[PaymentsUpdateRequest](#schemapaymentsupdaterequest)|true|none|
|» amount|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|The primary amount for the payment, provided in the lowest denomination of the specified currency (e.g., 6540 for $65.40 USD). This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|» order_tax_amount|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Total tax amount applicable to the order, in the lowest denomination of the currency.|
|» currency|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» amount_to_capture|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|The amount to be captured from the user's payment method, in the lowest denomination. If not provided, and `capture_method` is `automatic`, the full payment `amount` will be captured. If `capture_method` is `manual`, this can be specified in the `/capture` call. Must be less than or equal to the authorized amount.|
|» shipping_cost|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|The shipping cost for the payment. This is required for tax calculation in some regions.|
|» payment_id|body|string \| null|false|Optional. A merchant-provided unique identifier for the payment, contains 30 characters long (e.g., "pay_mbabizu24mvu3mela5njyhpit4"). If provided, it ensures idempotency for the payment creation request. If omitted, Hyperswitch generates a unique ID for the payment.|

## Payments - Confirm

<a id="opIdConfirm a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string/confirm \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "customer_acceptance": {
      "acceptance_type": "online",
      "accepted_at": "1963-05-03T04:07:52.723Z",
      "online": {
        "ip_address": "127.0.0.1",
        "user_agent": "amet irure esse"
      }
    },
    "payment_method": "card",
    "payment_method_data": {
      "card": {
        "card_cvc": "123",
        "card_exp_month": "10",
        "card_exp_year": "25",
        "card_holder_name": "joseph Doe",
        "card_number": "4242424242424242"
      }
    },
    "payment_method_type": "credit"
  }'
```

`POST /payments/{payment_id}/confirm`

Confirms a payment intent that was previously created with `confirm: false`. This action attempts to authorize the payment with the payment processor.

Expected status transitions after confirmation:
- `succeeded`: If authorization is successful and `capture_method` is `automatic`.
- `requires_capture`: If authorization is successful and `capture_method` is `manual`.
- `failed`: If authorization fails.
Profile-restricted requests are authorized against the stored payment before payment-method
prefetch, retry records, address updates, or other confirmation side effects.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "customer_acceptance": {
    "acceptance_type": "online",
    "accepted_at": "1963-05-03T04:07:52.723Z",
    "online": {
      "ip_address": "127.0.0.1",
      "user_agent": "amet irure esse"
    }
  },
  "payment_method": "card",
  "payment_method_data": {
    "card": {
      "card_cvc": "123",
      "card_exp_month": "10",
      "card_exp_year": "25",
      "card_holder_name": "joseph Doe",
      "card_number": "4242424242424242"
    }
  },
  "payment_method_type": "credit"
}
```

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key, publishable_key
</aside>

## Payments - Capture

<a id="opIdCapture a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string/capture \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "amount_to_capture": 654
  }'
```

`POST /payments/{payment_id}/capture`

Captures the funds for a previously authorized payment intent where `capture_method` was set to `manual` and the payment is in a `requires_capture` state.

Upon successful capture, the payment status usually transitions to `succeeded`.
The `amount_to_capture` can be specified in the request body; it must be less than or equal to the payment's `amount_capturable`. If omitted, the full capturable amount is captured.

A payment must be in a capturable state (e.g., `requires_capture`). Attempting to capture an already `succeeded` (and fully captured) payment or one in an invalid state will lead to an error.
When authentication restricts access to a profile, the payment must belong to that profile.
This authorization is checked before creating a capture record, including for multiple captures.
Payments outside the authenticated merchant/profile scope are treated as not found.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amount_to_capture": 654
}
```

<h3 id="payments---capture-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|path|string|true|The identifier for payment|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|
|body|body|[PaymentsCaptureRequest](#schemapaymentscapturerequest)|true|none|
|» merchant_id|body|string \| null|false|The unique identifier for the merchant. This is usually inferred from the API key.|
|» amount_to_capture|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|The amount to capture, in the lowest denomination of the currency. If omitted, the entire `amount_capturable` of the payment will be captured. Must be less than or equal to the current `amount_capturable`.|
|» refund_uncaptured_amount|body|boolean \| null|false|Decider to refund the uncaptured amount. (Currently not fully supported or behavior may vary by connector).|
|» statement_descriptor_suffix|body|string \| null|false|**Deprecated.** A dynamic suffix that appears on your customer's credit card statement. This is concatenated with the (shortened) descriptor prefix set on your account to form the complete statement descriptor. ## Payments - Session token

<a id="opIdCreate Session tokens for a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/session_tokens \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "payment_id": "string",
    "client_secret": "string",
    "wallets": [
      "ach"
    ],
    "merchant_connector_details": {
      "creds_identifier": "string",
      "encoded_data": {
        "connector_account_details": {},
        "metadata": {}
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /payments/session_tokens`

Creates a session object or a session token for wallets like Apple Pay, Google Pay, etc. These tokens are used by Hyperswitch's SDK to initiate these wallets' SDK.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "payment_id": "string",
  "client_secret": "string",
  "wallets": [
    "ach"
  ],
  "merchant_connector_details": {
    "creds_identifier": "string",
    "encoded_data": {
      "connector_account_details": {},
      "metadata": {}
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="payments---session-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PaymentsSessionRequest](#schemapaymentssessionrequest)|true|none|
|» payment_id|body|string|true|The identifier for the payment|
|» client_secret|body|string \| null|false|This is a token which expires after 15 minutes, used from the client to authenticate and create sessions from the SDK|
|» wallets|body|[[PaymentMethodType](#schemapaymentmethodtype)]|true|The list of the supported wallets|
|» merchant_connector_details|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » creds_identifier|body|string|true|Creds Identifier is to uniquely identify the credentials. Do not send any sensitive info, like encoded_data in this field. And do not send the string "null".|
|» » encoded_data|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » » connector_account_details|body|object \| null|false|Account details of the Connector. You can specify up to 50 keys, with key names up to 40 characters long and values up to 500 characters long. Useful for storing additional, structured information on an object.|
|» » » metadata|body|object \| null|false|Metadata is useful for storing additional, unstructured information on an object.|

## Payments - Cancel

<a id="opIdCancel a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string/cancel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "cancellation_reason": "requested_by_customer"
  }'
```

`POST /payments/{payment_id}/cancel`

A Payment could can be cancelled when it is in one of these statuses: `requires_payment_method`, `requires_capture`, `requires_confirmation`, `requires_customer_action`.
Profile-restricted authentication can cancel only payments in that profile.
Payments outside the authenticated merchant/profile scope are treated as not found before cancellation side effects.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cancellation_reason": "requested_by_customer"
}
```

|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|
|body|body|[PaymentsCancelRequest](#schemapaymentscancelrequest)|true|none|
|» cancellation_reason|body|string \| null|false|The reason for the payment cancel|
|» merchant_connector_details|body|object \| null|false|none|

|» » » metadata|body|object \| null|false|Metadata is useful for storing additional, unstructured information on an object.|

<h3 id="payments---cancel-post-capture-retrieve-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Payment canceled post capture|[PaymentsResponse](#schemapaymentsresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Missing mandatory fields|[GenericErrorResponseOpenApi](#schemagenericerrorresponseopenapi)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key
</aside>

## Payments - Cancel Post Capture

<a id="opIdCancel a Payment Post Capture"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string/cancel_post_capture \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "cancellation_reason": "requested_by_customer"
  }'
```

`POST /payments/{payment_id}/cancel_post_capture`

A Payment could can be cancelled when it is in one of these statuses: `succeeded`, `partially_captured`, `partially_captured_and_capturable`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cancellation_reason": "requested_by_customer"
}
```

api_key
</aside>

## Payments - Extended Authorization

<a id="opIdExtend authorization period for a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string/extend_authorization \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /payments/{payment_id}/extend_authorization`

Extended authorization is available for payments currently in the `requires_capture` status
Call this endpoint to increase the authorization validity period

<h3 id="payments---extended-authorization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|path|string|true|The identifier for payment|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error_type": "invalid_request",
  "message": "Missing required param: {param}",
  "code": "IR_04"
}
```

<h3 id="payments---extended-authorization-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Extended authorization for the payment|None|
|400|Bad Request|Missing mandatory fields|[GenericErrorResponseOpenApi](#schemagenericerrorresponseopenapi)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key
</aside>

## Payments - List

<a id="opIdList all Payments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/list \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /payments/list`

To list the *payments*

<h3 id="payments---list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer_id|query|string \| null|false|The identifier for the customer|
|starting_after|query|string \| null|false|A cursor for use in pagination, fetch the next list after some object|
|ending_before|query|string \| null|false|A cursor for use in pagination, fetch the previous list before some object|
|limit|query|integer(int64) \| null|false|Limit on the number of objects to return|
|created|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|The time at which payment is created|
|created_lt|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Time less than the payment created time|
|created_gt|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Time greater than the payment created time|
|created_lte|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Time less than or equals to the payment created time|
|created_gte|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Time greater than or equals to the payment created time|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|

<h3 id="payments---list-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successfully retrieved a payment list|Inline|
|404|Not Found|No payments found|None|

<h3 id="payments---list-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[PaymentListResponse](#schemapaymentlistresponse)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key
</aside>

## Payments - Incremental Authorization

<a id="opIdIncrement authorized amount for a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string/incremental_authorization \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 6540,
    "reason": "string",
    "payment_method_data": {
      "card": {
        "card_number": "4242424242424242",
        "card_exp_month": "24",
        "card_exp_year": "24",
        "card_holder_name": "John Test",
        "card_cvc": "242",
        "card_issuer": "chase",
        "card_network": {},
        "card_type": "CREDIT",
        "card_subtype": "CLASSIC",
        "card_segment_type": {},
        "funding_source": {},
        "card_issuing_country": "INDIA",
        "card_issuing_country_code": "IN",
        "bank_code": "JP_AMEX",
        "nick_name": "John Test"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /payments/{payment_id}/incremental_authorization`

Authorized amount for a payment can be incremented if it is in status: requires_capture

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amount": 6540,
  "reason": "string",
  "payment_method_data": {
    "card": {
      "card_number": "4242424242424242",
      "card_exp_month": "24",
      "card_exp_year": "24",
      "card_holder_name": "John Test",
      "card_cvc": "242",
      "card_issuer": "chase",
      "card_network": {},
      "card_type": "CREDIT",
      "card_subtype": "CLASSIC",
      "card_segment_type": {},
      "funding_source": {},
      "card_issuing_country": "INDIA",
      "card_issuing_country_code": "IN",
      "bank_code": "JP_AMEX",
      "nick_name": "John Test"
    }
  }
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|path|string|true|The identifier for payment|

|body|body|[PaymentsIncrementalAuthorizationRequest](#schemapaymentsincrementalauthorizationrequest)|true|none|
|» amount|body|integer(int64)|true|The total amount including previously authorized amount and additional amount|

|» » vault_card_token_data|body|[VaultCardToken](#schemavaultcardtoken)|true|Card token data carried by the external vault proxy `vault_card_token_data` variant. Its<br>`card_cvc` is a vault token detokenized on the wire by the external vault (e.g. VGS). Kept as a<br>distinct type from [`CardToken`] so the self-hosted `card_cvc_token` field does not leak into<br>the proxy contract.|

## Payments Link - Retrieve

<a id="opIdRetrieve a Payment Link"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payment_link/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /payment_link/{payment_link_id}`

To retrieve the properties of a Payment Link. This may be used to get the status of a previously initiated payment or next action for an ongoing payment

<h3 id="payments-link---retrieve-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_link_id|path|string|true|The identifier for payment link|
|client_secret|query|string \| null|false|This is a token which expires after 15 minutes, used from the client to authenticate and create sessions from the SDK|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "payment_link_id": "string",
  "payment_id": "string",
  "merchant_id": "string",
  "processor_merchant_id": "string",
  "profile_id": "string",
  "link_to_pay": "string",
  "amount": 6540,
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "expiry": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "description": "string",
  "status": "active",
  "currency": {},
  "secure_link": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="payments-link---retrieve-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Gets details regarding payment link|[RetrievePaymentLinkResponse](#schemaretrievepaymentlinkresponse)|
|404|Not Found|No payment link found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key, publishable_key
</aside>

## Payments - External 3DS Authentication

<a id="opIdInitiate external authentication for a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string/3ds/authentication \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "client_secret": "string",
    "sdk_information": {
      "sdk_app_id": "string",
      "sdk_enc_data": "string",
      "sdk_ephem_pub_key": {
        "property1": "string",
        "property2": "string"
      },
      "sdk_trans_id": "string",
      "sdk_reference_number": "string",
      "sdk_max_timeout": 0,
      "sdk_type": {},
      "device_details": {
        "device_type": "string",
        "device_brand": "string",
        "device_os": "string",
        "device_display": "string"
      }
    },
    "device_channel": "APP",
    "threeds_method_comp_ind": "Y"
  }'
```

`POST /payments/{payment_id}/3ds/authentication`

External 3DS Authentication is performed and returns the AuthenticationResponse

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "client_secret": "string",
  "sdk_information": {
    "sdk_app_id": "string",
    "sdk_enc_data": "string",
    "sdk_ephem_pub_key": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    },
    "sdk_trans_id": "string",
    "sdk_reference_number": "string",
    "sdk_max_timeout": 0,
    "sdk_type": {},
    "device_details": {
      "device_type": "string",
      "device_brand": "string",
      "device_os": "string",
      "device_display": "string"
    }
  },
  "device_channel": "APP",
  "threeds_method_comp_ind": "Y"
}
```

<h3 id="payments---external-3ds-authentication-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|path|string|true|The identifier for payment|
|body|body|[PaymentsExternalAuthenticationRequest](#schemapaymentsexternalauthenticationrequest)|true|none|
|» client_secret|body|string \| null|false|Client Secret|
|» sdk_information|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » sdk_app_id|body|string|true|Unique ID created on installations of the 3DS Requestor App on a Consumer Device|
|» » sdk_enc_data|body|string|true|JWE Object containing data encrypted by the SDK for the DS to decrypt|
|» » sdk_ephem_pub_key|body|object|true|Public key component of the ephemeral key pair generated by the 3DS SDK|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » sdk_trans_id|body|string|true|Unique transaction identifier assigned by the 3DS SDK|
|» » sdk_reference_number|body|string|true|Identifies the vendor and version for the 3DS SDK that is integrated in a 3DS Requestor App|
|» » sdk_max_timeout|body|integer(int32)|true|Indicates maximum amount of time in minutes|
|» » sdk_type|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » device_details|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » » device_type|body|string \| null|false|Device type|
|» » » device_brand|body|string \| null|false|Device brand|
|» » » device_os|body|string \| null|false|Device OS|
|» » » device_display|body|string \| null|false|Device display|
|» device_channel|body|[DeviceChannel](#schemadevicechannel)|true|Device Channel indicating whether request is coming from App or Browser|
|» threeds_method_comp_ind|body|[ThreeDsCompletionIndicator](#schemathreedscompletionindicator)|true|Indicates if 3DS method data was successfully completed or not|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» device_channel|APP|
|» device_channel|BRW|
|» threeds_method_comp_ind|Y|
|» threeds_method_comp_ind|N|
|» threeds_method_comp_ind|U|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "trans_status": "Y",
  "acs_url": "string",
  "challenge_request": "string",
  "challenge_request_key": "string",
  "acs_reference_number": "string",
  "acs_trans_id": "string",
  "three_dsserver_trans_id": "string",
  "acs_signed_content": "string",
  "three_ds_requestor_url": "string",
  "three_ds_requestor_app_url": "string",
  "error_message": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "error_type": "invalid_request",
  "message": "Missing required param: {param}",
  "code": "IR_04"
}
```

<h3 id="payments---external-3ds-authentication-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Authentication created|[PaymentsExternalAuthenticationResponse](#schemapaymentsexternalauthenticationresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Missing mandatory fields|[GenericErrorResponseOpenApi](#schemagenericerrorresponseopenapi)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
publishable_key
</aside>

## Payments - Post Session Tokens

<a id="opIdCreate Post Session Tokens for a Payment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string/post_session_tokens \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "client_secret": "string",
    "payment_method_type": "ach",
    "payment_method": "card"
  }'
```

`POST /payments/{payment_id}/post_session_tokens`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "client_secret": "string",
  "payment_method_type": "ach",
  "payment_method": "card"
}
```

<h3 id="payments---post-session-tokens-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|path|string|true|The identifier for payment|
|body|body|[PaymentsPostSessionTokensRequest](#schemapaymentspostsessiontokensrequest)|true|none|
|» client_secret|body|string \| null|false|It's a token used for client side verification.|
|» payment_method_type|body|[PaymentMethodType](#schemapaymentmethodtype)|true|Indicates the sub type of payment method. Eg: 'google_pay' & 'apple_pay' for wallets.|
|» payment_method|body|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|Indicates the type of payment method. Eg: 'card', 'wallet', etc.|

|---|---|---|---|

publishable_key
</aside>

`POST /payments/{payment_id}/eligibility`

Runs eligibility checks (blocklist, card testing guard) and calculates an external surcharge
in a single call. Intended to be called by the SDK before the final confirm step.

- If eligibility is denied the response will contain `sdk_next_action: deny` and no surcharge details.
- If the merchant has no surcharge connector configured, `surcharge_details` will be `null`.
- A connector calculation error leaves the payment payable amount unchanged. Its surcharge
details contain a zero surcharge and the connector message. The error code is included
only when the connector supplies one.
- If no calculation is attempted, `surcharge_details` is `null`.

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-refunds">Refunds</h1>

Create and manage refunds for successful payments

## Refunds - Create

<a id="opIdCreate a Refund"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/refunds \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 654,
    "payment_id": "{{payment_id}}",
    "refund_type": "instant"
  }'
```

`POST /refunds`

Creates a refund against an already processed payment. In case of some processors, you can even opt to refund only a partial amount multiple times until the original charge amount has been refunded

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "amount": 654,
  "payment_id": "{{payment_id}}",
  "refund_type": "instant"
}
```

<h3 id="refunds---create-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|
|body|body|[RefundRequest](#schemarefundrequest)|true|none|
|» payment_id|body|string|true|The payment id against which refund is to be initiated|
|» refund_id|body|string \| null|false|Unique Identifier for the Refund. This is to ensure idempotency for multiple partial refunds initiated against the same payment. If this is not passed by the merchant, this field shall be auto generated and provided in the API response. It is recommended to generate uuid(v4) as the refund_id.|
|» merchant_id|body|string \| null|false|The identifier for the Merchant Account|
|» amount|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|Total amount for which the refund is to be initiated. Amount for the payment in lowest denomination of the currency. (i.e) in cents for USD denomination, in paisa for INR denomination etc., If not provided, this will default to the full payment amount|
|» reason|body|string \| null|false|Reason for the refund. Often useful for displaying to users and your customer support executive. In case the payment went through Stripe, this field needs to be passed with one of these enums: `duplicate`, `fraudulent`, or `requested_by_customer`|

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-customers">Customers</h1>

Create and manage customers

## Customers - Create

<a id="opIdCreate a Customer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/customers \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "email": "guest@example.com",
    "name": "John Doe"
  }'
```

`POST /customers`

Creates a customer object and stores the customer details to be reused for future payments.
Incase the customer already exists in the system, this API will respond with the customer details.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "email": "guest@example.com",
  "name": "John Doe"
}
```

<h3 id="customers---create-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CustomerRequest](#schemacustomerrequest)|true|none|
|» customer_id|body|string \| null|false|The identifier for the customer object. If not provided the customer ID will be autogenerated.|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|The customer's name|
|» email|body|string \| null|false|The customer's email address|
|» phone|body|string \| null|false|The customer's phone number|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|An arbitrary string that you can attach to a customer object.|
|» phone_country_code|body|string \| null|false|The country code for the customer phone number|
|» address|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » city|body|string \| null|false|The city, district, suburb, town, or village of the address.|
|» » country|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » line1|body|string \| null|false|The first line of the street address or P.O. Box.|
|» » line2|body|string \| null|false|The second line of the street address or P.O. Box (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building).|
|» » line3|body|string \| null|false|The third line of the street address, if applicable.|
|» » zip|body|string \| null|false|The zip/postal code for the address|
|» » state|body|string \| null|false|The address state|
|» » first_name|body|string \| null|false|The first name for the address|
|» » last_name|body|string \| null|false|The last name for the address|
|» » origin_zip|body|string \| null|false|The zip/postal code of the origin|
|» metadata|body|object \| null|false|You can specify up to 50 keys, with key names up to 40 characters long and values up to 500<br>characters long. Metadata is useful for storing additional, structured information on an<br>object.|
|» tax_registration_id|body|string \| null|false|Customer's tax registration ID|
|» document_details|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » document_type|body|[DocumentKind](#schemadocumentkind)|true|Represents the type of identification document used for validation.|
|» » document_number|body|string|true|The customer's document number<br>Length of the document number depends upon the document_type.<br>For CPF/CNPJ it is typically 11/14 digits long|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|

|» » document_type|cnpj|
|» » document_type|psn|
|» » document_type|other|

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-payment-methods">Payment Methods</h1>

Create and manage payment methods of customers

## PaymentMethods - Create

<a id="opIdCreate a Payment Method"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payment_methods \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "card": {
      "card_exp_month": "11",
      "card_exp_year": "30",
      "card_holder_name": "John Doe",
      "card_number": "4242424242424242"
    },
    "customer_id": "{{customer_id}}",
    "payment_method": "card",
    "payment_method_issuer": "Visa",
    "payment_method_type": "credit"
  }'
```

`POST /payment_methods`

Creates and stores a payment method against a customer.
In case of cards, this API should be used only by PCI compliant merchants.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "card": {
    "card_exp_month": "11",
    "card_exp_year": "30",
    "card_holder_name": "John Doe",
    "card_number": "4242424242424242"
  },
  "customer_id": "{{customer_id}}",
  "payment_method": "card",
  "payment_method_issuer": "Visa",
  "payment_method_type": "credit"
}
```

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key
</aside>

## List payment methods for a Merchant

<a id="opIdList all Payment Methods for a Merchant"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/account/payment_methods \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /account/payment_methods`

Lists the applicable payment methods for a particular Merchant ID.
Use the client secret and publishable key authorization to list all relevant payment methods of the merchant for the payment corresponding to the client secret.

<h3 id="list-payment-methods-for-a-merchant-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|client_secret|query|string \| null|false|This is a token which expires after 15 minutes, used from the client to authenticate and create sessions from the SDK|
|accepted_countries|query|[[CountryAlpha2](#schemacountryalpha2)]|false|The two-letter ISO currency code|
|accepted_currencies|query|[[Currency](#schemacurrency)]|false|The three-letter ISO currency code|
|amount|query|integer(int64) \| null|false|The amount accepted for processing by the particular payment method.|
|recurring_enabled|query|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for recurring payments|
|installment_payment_enabled|query|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for installment payments|
|limit|query|integer(int64) \| null|false|Indicates the limit of last used payment methods|
|card_networks|query|[[CardNetwork](#schemacardnetwork)]|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for card netwotks|

<h3 id="list-payment-methods-for-a-merchant-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Payment Methods retrieved|[PaymentMethodListResponse](#schemapaymentmethodlistresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid Data|None|
|404|Not Found|Payment Methods does not exist in records|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key, publishable_key
</aside>

## List payment methods for a Customer

<a id="opIdList all Payment Methods for a Customer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/customers/string/payment_methods \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /customers/{customer_id}/payment_methods`

Lists all the applicable payment methods for a particular Customer ID.

<h3 id="list-payment-methods-for-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the customer account|
|client_secret|query|string \| null|false|This is a token which expires after 15 minutes, used from the client to authenticate and create sessions from the SDK|
|accepted_countries|query|[[CountryAlpha2](#schemacountryalpha2)]|false|The two-letter ISO currency code|
|accepted_currencies|query|[[Currency](#schemacurrency)]|false|The three-letter ISO currency code|
|amount|query|integer(int64) \| null|false|The amount accepted for processing by the particular payment method.|
|recurring_enabled|query|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for recurring payments|
|installment_payment_enabled|query|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for installment payments|
|limit|query|integer(int64) \| null|false|Indicates the limit of last used payment methods|
|card_networks|query|[[CardNetwork](#schemacardnetwork)]|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for card netwotks|

## List customer saved payment methods for a Payment

<a id="opIdList Customer Payment Methods via Client Secret"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/customers/payment_methods \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /customers/payment_methods`

Lists all the applicable payment methods for a particular payment tied to the `client_secret`.

|accepted_currencies|query|[[Currency](#schemacurrency)]|false|The three-letter ISO currency code|

|recurring_enabled|query|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for recurring payments|
|installment_payment_enabled|query|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for installment payments|
|limit|query|integer(int64) \| null|false|Indicates the limit of last used payment methods|
|card_networks|query|[[CardNetwork](#schemacardnetwork)]|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for card netwotks|

## List payment methods for a Payment

<a id="opIdList Payment Methods for a Payment via Client SDK"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payments/string/client \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /payments/{payment_id}/client`

Client SDK endpoint. Returns a unified response combining merchant-enabled
payment methods and customer saved payment methods, filtered via Euclid
constraint graph and session flow routing.

Supported auth:
- SDK auth via `Authorization`.
- Publishable-key auth via `api-key: pk_...` and `client_secret` query param.
- Merchant API-key auth via `api-key: <api_key>`.

<h3 id="list-payment-methods-for-a-payment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|path|string|true|The identifier for the payment|
|client_secret|query|string \| null|false|This is a token which expires after 15 minutes, used from the client to authenticate and create sessions from the SDK|
|accepted_countries|query|[[CountryAlpha2](#schemacountryalpha2)]|false|The two-letter ISO currency code|
|accepted_currencies|query|[[Currency](#schemacurrency)]|false|The three-letter ISO currency code|
|amount|query|integer(int64) \| null|false|The amount accepted for processing by the particular payment method.|
|recurring_enabled|query|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for recurring payments|
|installment_payment_enabled|query|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for installment payments|
|limit|query|integer(int64) \| null|false|Indicates the limit of last used payment methods|
|card_networks|query|[[CardNetwork](#schemacardnetwork)]|false|Indicates whether the payment method is eligible for card netwotks|

## Payment Method - Set Default Payment Method for Customer

<a id="opIdSet the Payment Method as Default"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/string/payment_methods/string/default \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /{customer_id}/payment_methods/{payment_method_id}/default`

Set the Payment Method as Default for the Customer.

<h3 id="payment-method---set-default-payment-method-for-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the Customer|
|payment_method_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the Payment Method|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "default_payment_method_id": "card_rGK4Vi5iSW70MY7J2mIg",
  "customer_id": "cus_y3oqhf46pyzuxjbcn2giaqnb44",
  "payment_method": "card",
  "payment_method_type": {}
}
```

<h3 id="payment-method---set-default-payment-method-for-customer-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Payment Method has been set as default|[CustomerDefaultPaymentMethodResponse](#schemacustomerdefaultpaymentmethodresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Payment Method has already been set as default for that customer|None|
|404|Not Found|Payment Method not found for the customer|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
ephemeral_key
</aside>

## Payment Method - Delete

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payment_methods/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /payment_methods/{method_id}`

```bash
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "update_last_used_at": true,
    "card": {
      "card_exp_month": "10",

      "nick_name": "John Doe",

      "issuer_country": "US",
      "issuer_country_code": "US",
      "card_network": "VISA"
    },
```

`POST /payment_methods/{method_id}/update`

This API is useful for use cases such as updating the card number for expired cards to prevent discontinuity in recurring payments.

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-api-key">API Key</h1>

## API Key - Create

<a id="opIdCreate an API Key"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/api_keys/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Sandbox integration key",
    "description": "Key used by our developers to integrate with the sandbox environment",
    "expiration": "never"
  }'
```

`POST /api_keys/{merchant_id}`

Create a new API Key for accessing our APIs from your servers. The plaintext API Key will be
displayed only once on creation, so ensure you store it securely.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Sandbox integration key",
  "description": "Key used by our developers to integrate with the sandbox environment",
  "expiration": "never"
}
```

<h3 id="api-key---create-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|merchant_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the merchant account|
|body|body|[CreateApiKeyRequest](#schemacreateapikeyrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|A unique name for the API Key to help you identify it.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|A description to provide more context about the API Key.|
|» expiration|body|[ApiKeyExpiration](#schemaapikeyexpiration)|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "key_id": "5hEEqkgJUyuxgSKGArHA4mWSnX",
  "merchant_id": "y3oqhf46pyzuxjbcn2giaqnb44",
  "name": "Sandbox integration key",
  "description": "Key used by our developers to integrate with the sandbox environment",
  "api_key": "string",
  "created": "2022-09-10T10:11:12Z",
  "expiration": "never"
}
```

<h3 id="api-key---create-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|API Key created|[CreateApiKeyResponse](#schemacreateapikeyresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid data|None|

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payouts/create \

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 1000,
    "auto_fulfill": true,
    "confirm": true,
    "connector": [
      "cybersource"
    ],
    "currency": "USD",
    "customer_id": "cus_external_vault_123",
    "entity_type": "Individual",
    "merchant_order_reference_id": "merchant_payout_1001",
    "payout_id": "payout_proxy_merchant_1001",
    "payout_method_id": "pm_external_vault_123",
    "payout_type": "card",
    "profile_id": "pro_external_vault_123",
    "recurring": false
  }'
```

`POST /payouts/create`

|» amount|body|integer(int64) \| null|false|The payout amount. Amount for the payout in lowest denomination of the currency. (i.e) in cents for USD denomination, in paisa for INR denomination etc.,|
|» currency|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» routing|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|

|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » data|body|[ProgramThreeDsDecisionRule](#schemaprogramthreedsdecisionrule)|true|none|
|» connector|body|[[PayoutConnectors](#schemapayoutconnectors)]|false|This field allows the merchant to manually select a connector with which the payout can go through.|
|» confirm|body|boolean \| null|false|This field is used when merchant wants to confirm the payout, thus useful for the payout _Confirm_ request. Ideally merchants should _Create_ a payout, _Update_ it (if required), then _Confirm_ it.|
|» payout_type|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» payout_method_data|body|object \| null|false|none|

## Payouts - List using filters

<a id="opIdFilter payouts using specific constraints"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/payouts/list \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "start_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "end_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "payout_id": "187282ab-40ef-47a9-9206-5099ba31e432",
    "merchant_order_reference_id": "merchant_order_ref_123",
    "profile_id": "string",
    "customer_id": "cus_y3oqhf46pyzuxjbcn2giaqnb44",
    "limit": 1,
    "offset": 0,
    "connector": [
      "wise",
      "adyen"
    ],
    "currency": "AED",
    "status": [
      "pending",
      "failed"
    ],
    "payout_method": [
      "bank",
      "card"
    ],
    "entity_type": "Individual"
  }'
```

`POST /payouts/list`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "start_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "end_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "payout_id": "187282ab-40ef-47a9-9206-5099ba31e432",
  "merchant_order_reference_id": "merchant_order_ref_123",
  "profile_id": "string",
  "customer_id": "cus_y3oqhf46pyzuxjbcn2giaqnb44",
  "limit": 1,
  "offset": 0,
  "connector": [
    "wise",
    "adyen"
  ],
  "currency": "AED",
  "status": [
    "pending",
    "failed"
  ],
  "payout_method": [
    "bank",
    "card"
  ],
  "entity_type": "Individual"
}
```

<h3 id="payouts---list-using-filters-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PayoutListFilterConstraints](#schemapayoutlistfilterconstraints)|true|none|
|» start_time|body|string(date-time)|true|The start time to filter payments list or to get list of filters. To get list of filters start time is needed to be passed|
|» end_time|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|The end time to filter payments list or to get list of filters. If not passed the default time is now|
|» payout_id|body|string \| null|false|The identifier for payout|
|» merchant_order_reference_id|body|string \| null|false|The merchant order reference ID for payout|
|» profile_id|body|string \| null|false|The identifier for business profile|
|» customer_id|body|string \| null|false|The identifier for customer|
|» limit|body|[common_utils.types.list.PageSize](#schemacommon_utils.types.list.pagesize)|false|none|
|» offset|body|[common_utils.types.list.PageOffset](#schemacommon_utils.types.list.pageoffset)|false|none|
|» connector|body|[[PayoutConnectors](#schemapayoutconnectors)]|false|The list of connectors to filter payouts list|
|» currency|body|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "USD", "EUR") for the payment amount. This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|» status|body|[[PayoutStatus](#schemapayoutstatus)]|false|The list of payout status to filter payouts list|
|» payout_method|body|[[PayoutType](#schemapayouttype)]|false|The list of payout methods to filter payouts list|
|» entity_type|body|[PayoutEntityType](#schemapayoutentitytype)|true|Type of entity to whom the payout is being carried out to, select from the given list of options|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» connector|adyen|
|» connector|adyenplatform|
|» connector|cybersource|
|» connector|deutschebank|
|» connector|ebanx|
|» connector|gigadat|
|» connector|gotyme_sanlam|
|» connector|loonio|
|» connector|mifinity|
|» connector|nomupay|
|» connector|nuvei|
|» connector|payone|
|» connector|paypal|

## Routing - Create

<a id="opIdCreate a routing config"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/routing \

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

  -d '{

    "algorithm": {
      "type": "single",
      "data": {

        "merchant_connector_id": "string"
      }
    },
    "profile_id": "profile_123",
    "transaction_type": {}
  }'
```

`POST /routing`

Create a routing config

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "default_card_routing",
  "description": "Primary routing strategy for card payments in Middle east",
  "algorithm": {
    "type": "single",
    "data": {
      "connector": "absa_sanlam",
      "merchant_connector_id": "string"
    }
  },
  "profile_id": "profile_123",
  "transaction_type": {}
}
```

|» algorithm|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|

|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|

|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » data|body|[ProgramThreeDsDecisionRule](#schemaprogramthreedsdecisionrule)|true|none|
|» profile_id|body|string \| null|false|Profile ID associated with this routing configuration.<br><br>Routing configs can be scoped per business profile.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"profile_123"<br>```|
|» transaction_type|body|object \| null|false|none|

|body|body|[RoutingEvaluateRequest](#schemaroutingevaluaterequest)|true|none|
|» created_by|body|string|true|Identifier of the user/system triggering routing evaluation.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"created_by": "some_id"<br>```|
|» payment_id|body|string \| null|false|Payment ID for debugging and tracing routing decisions.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"payment_id": "pay_abc123"<br>```|
|» parameters|body|object|true|Dynamic parameters used during routing evaluation.<br><br>Each key represents a routing attribute.<br><br>Example fields:<br><br>- `payment_method`<br>- `payment_method_type`<br>- `amount`<br>- `currency`<br>- `authentication_type`<br>- `card_bin`<br>- `capture_method`<br>- `business_country`<br>- `billing_country`<br>- `business_label`<br>- `setup_future_usage`<br>- `card_network`<br>- `payment_type`<br>- `mandate_type`<br>- `mandate_acceptance_type`<br>- `metadata`<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>{<br>"payment_method": { "type": "enum_variant", "value": "card" },<br>"amount": { "type": "number", "value": 10 },<br>"currency": { "type": "str_value", "value": "INR" },<br>"authentication_type": { "type": "enum_variant", "value": "three_ds" },<br>"card_bin": { "type": "str_value", "value": "424242" },<br>"business_country": { "type": "str_value", "value": "IN" },<br>"setup_future_usage": { "type": "enum_variant", "value": "off_session" },<br>"card_network": { "type": "enum_variant", "value": "visa" },<br>"metadata": {<br>"type": "metadata_variant",<br>"value": { "key": "key1", "value": "value1" }<br>}<br>}<br>```<br><br>For the complete superset of supported routing keys,<br>refer to `routing_configs.keys` in:<br>https://github.com/juspay/decision-engine/blob/main/config/development.toml|
|» fallback_output|body|[[DeRoutableConnectorChoice](#schemaderoutableconnectorchoice)]|true|Fallback connectors used if routing rule evaluation fails.<br><br>These connectors will be returned if no rule matches.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>[<br>{<br>"gateway_name": "stripe",<br>"gateway_id": "mca_123"<br>}<br>]<br>```|
|» algorithm_for|body|object \| null|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "output": null,
  "evaluated_output": [
    {
      "connector": "absa_sanlam",
      "merchant_connector_id": "string"
    }
  ],
  "eligible_connectors": [
    {
      "connector": "absa_sanlam",
      "merchant_connector_id": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="routing---rule-evaluate-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Routing rules evaluated successfully|[RoutingEvaluateResponse](#schemaroutingevaluateresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Request body is malformed|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Resource missing|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable request|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key
</aside>

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-event">Event</h1>

## Events - List

<a id="opIdList all Events associated with a Merchant Account or Profile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/events/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "created_after": "2023-01-01T00:00:00",
    "created_before": "2023-01-31T23:59:59",
    "event_classes": [
      "payments",
      "refunds"
    ],
    "event_types": [
      "payment_succeeded"
    ],
    "is_delivered": true,
    "limit": 5,
    "object_id": "{{object_id}}",
    "offset": 0,
    "profile_id": "{{profile_id}}"
  }'
```

`POST /events/{merchant_id}`

List all Events associated with a Merchant Account or Profile.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "created_after": "2023-01-01T00:00:00",
  "created_before": "2023-01-31T23:59:59",
  "event_classes": [
    "payments",
    "refunds"
  ],
  "event_types": [
    "payment_succeeded"
  ],
  "is_delivered": true,
  "limit": 5,
  "object_id": "{{object_id}}",
  "offset": 0,
  "profile_id": "{{profile_id}}"
}
```

<h3 id="events---list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|merchant_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the Merchant Account.|
|body|body|[EventListConstraints](#schemaeventlistconstraints)|true|The constraints that can be applied when listing Events.|
|» created_after|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Filter events created after the specified time.|
|» created_before|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Filter events created before the specified time.|
|» limit|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Include at most the specified number of events.|
|» offset|body|integer(int32) \| null|false|Include events after the specified offset.|

|» profile_id|body|string \| null|false|Filter all events associated with the specified business profile ID.|

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-authentication">Authentication</h1>

## Authentication - Create

<a id="opIdCreate an Authentication"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/authentication \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "authentication_id": "auth_mbabizu24mvu3mela5njyhpit4",
    "profile_id": "string",
    "amount": 0,
    "authentication_connector": {},
    "currency": "AED",
    "return_url": "https://example.com/redirect",
    "force_3ds_challenge": true,
    "psd2_sca_exemption_type": {},
    "profile_acquirer_id": "string",
    "acquirer_details": {
      "acquirer_bin": "123456",
      "acquirer_merchant_id": "merchant_abc",
      "merchant_country_code": "US/34456"
    },
    "customer_details": {
      "id": "cus_y3oqhf46pyzuxjbcn2giaqnb44",
      "name": "John Doe",
      "email": "johntest@test.com",
      "phone": "9123456789",
      "phone_country_code": "+1",
      "tax_registration_id": "string",
      "document_details": {
        "document_type": "cpf",
        "document_number": "12345678911"
      },
      "date_of_birth": "1990-01-31"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /authentication/{authentication_id}/authenticate`

```json
      "property1": "string",

    },

  "threeds_method_comp_ind": "Y"
}
```

<h3 id="authentication---authenticate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AuthenticationAuthenticateRequest](#schemaauthenticationauthenticaterequest)|true|none|
|» client_secret|body|string|true|Client secret for the authentication|
|» sdk_information|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » sdk_app_id|body|string|true|Unique ID created on installations of the 3DS Requestor App on a Consumer Device|

|» » sdk_ephem_pub_key|body|object|true|Public key component of the ephemeral key pair generated by the 3DS SDK|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » sdk_trans_id|body|string|true|Unique transaction identifier assigned by the 3DS SDK|
|» » sdk_reference_number|body|string|true|Identifies the vendor and version for the 3DS SDK that is integrated in a 3DS Requestor App|
|» » sdk_max_timeout|body|integer(int32)|true|Indicates maximum amount of time in minutes|
|» » sdk_type|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » device_details|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » » device_type|body|string \| null|false|Device type|
|» » » device_brand|body|string \| null|false|Device brand|
|» » » device_os|body|string \| null|false|Device OS|
|» » » device_display|body|string \| null|false|Device display|
|» device_channel|body|[DeviceChannel](#schemadevicechannel)|true|Device Channel indicating whether request is coming from App or Browser|
|» threeds_method_comp_ind|body|[ThreeDsCompletionIndicator](#schemathreedscompletionindicator)|true|Indicates if 3DS method data was successfully completed or not|

## Subscription - Create

<a id="opIdCreate Subscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/subscriptions/create \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H 'X-Profile-Id: string' \
  -d '{
    "customer_id": "cust_123456789",
    "item_price_id": "standard-plan-USD-Monthly",
    "payment_details": {
      "authentication_type": "no_three_ds",
      "capture_method": "automatic",
      "return_url": "https://google.com",
      "setup_future_usage": "off_session"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /subscriptions/create`

Creates a subscription that requires separate confirmation.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_123456789",
  "item_price_id": "standard-plan-USD-Monthly",
  "payment_details": {
    "authentication_type": "no_three_ds",
    "capture_method": "automatic",
    "return_url": "https://google.com",
    "setup_future_usage": "off_session"
  }
}
```

## Subscription - Get Items

<a id="opIdGet Subscription Items"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/subscriptions/items?item_type=plan' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H 'X-Profile-Id: string'
```

`GET /subscriptions/items`

Retrieves available subscription items.

<h3 id="subscription---get-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Profile-Id|header|string|true|Profile ID for authentication|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Number of items to retrieve|
|offset|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Number of items to skip|
|product_id|query|string \| null|false|Filter by product ID|
|item_type|query|[SubscriptionItemType](#schemasubscriptionitemtype)|true|Filter by subscription item type plan or addon|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|item_type|plan|
|item_type|addon|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "item_id": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "price_id": [
      {
        "price_id": "string",
        "item_id": "string",
        "amount": 0,
        "currency": "AED",
        "interval": "Day",
        "interval_count": 0,
        "trial_period": 0,
        "trial_period_unit": {}
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

<h3 id="subscription---get-items-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

`POST /relay`

Creates a relay request.

```json
{
  "connector_id": "mca_5apGeP94tMts6rg3U3kR",
```

|body|body|[RelayRequest](#schemarelayrequest)|true|none|
|» connector_resource_id|body|string|true|The identifier that is associated to a resource at the connector reference to which the relay request is being made|
|» connector_id|body|string|true|Identifier of the connector ( merchant connector account ) which was chosen to make the payment|
|» type|body|[RelayType](#schemarelaytype)|true|none|
|» data|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » refund|body|[RelayRefundRequestData](#schemarelayrefundrequestdata)|true|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » capture|body|[RelayCaptureRequestData](#schemarelaycapturerequestdata)|true|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » incremental_authorization|body|[RelayIncrementalAuthorizationRequestData](#schemarelayincrementalauthorizationrequestdata)|true|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » void|body|[RelayVoidRequestData](#schemarelayvoidrequestdata)|true|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » unreferenced_refund|body|[RelayUnreferencedRefundData](#schemarelayunreferencedrefunddata)|true|none|

|» type|void|
|» type|unreferenced_refund|
