<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-organization">Organization</h1>

## Organization - Create

<a id="opIdCreate an Organization"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/organization \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "organization_name": "organization_abc"
  }'
```

`POST /organization`

Create a new organization

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "organization_name": "organization_abc"
}
```

<h3 id="organization---create-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[OrganizationCreateRequest](#schemaorganizationcreaterequest)|true|none|
|» organization_name|body|string|true|Name of the organization|
|» organization_details|body|object \| null|false|Details about the organization|
|» metadata|body|object \| null|false|Metadata is useful for storing additional, unstructured information on an object.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "organization_id": "org_q98uSGAYbjEwqs0mJwnz",
  "organization_name": "string",
  "organization_details": {},
  "metadata": {},
  "modified_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "organization_type": {}
}
```

<h3 id="organization---create-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Organization Created|[OrganizationResponse](#schemaorganizationresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid data|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
admin_api_key
</aside>

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-gsm">Gsm</h1>

## Gsm - Create

<a id="opIdCreate Gsm Rule"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/gsm \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "connector": "absa_sanlam",
    "flow": "string",
    "sub_flow": "string",
    "code": "string",
    "message": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "router_error": "string",
    "decision": "retry",
    "step_up_possible": true,
    "unified_code": "string",
    "unified_message": "string",
    "error_category": {},
    "clear_pan_possible": true,
    "feature": {},
    "feature_data": {
      "retry": {
        "step_up_possible": true,
        "clear_pan_possible": true,
        "alternate_network_possible": true,
        "decision": "retry"
      }
    },
    "standardised_code": {},
    "description": "string",
    "user_guidance_message": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /gsm`

Creates a GSM (Global Status Mapping) Rule. A GSM rule is used to map a connector's error message/error code combination during a particular payments flow/sub-flow to Hyperswitch's unified status/error code/error message combination. It is also used to decide the next action in the flow - retry/requeue/do_default

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "connector": "absa_sanlam",
  "flow": "string",
  "sub_flow": "string",
  "code": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "status": "string",
  "router_error": "string",
  "decision": "retry",
  "step_up_possible": true,
  "unified_code": "string",
  "unified_message": "string",
  "error_category": {},
  "clear_pan_possible": true,
  "feature": {},
  "feature_data": {
    "retry": {
      "step_up_possible": true,
      "clear_pan_possible": true,
      "alternate_network_possible": true,
      "decision": "retry"
    }
  },
  "standardised_code": {},
  "description": "string",
  "user_guidance_message": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="gsm---create-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[GsmCreateRequest](#schemagsmcreaterequest)|true|none|
|» connector|body|[Connector](#schemaconnector)|true|none|
|» flow|body|string|true|The flow in which the code and message occurred for a connector|
|» sub_flow|body|string|true|The sub_flow in which the code and message occurred  for a connector|
|» code|body|string|true|code received from the connector|
|» message|body|string|true|message received from the connector|
|» status|body|string|true|status provided by the router|
|» router_error|body|string \| null|false|optional error provided by the router|
|» decision|body|[GsmDecision](#schemagsmdecision)|true|none|
|» step_up_possible|body|boolean|true|**Deprecated.** indicates if step_up retry is possible<br>**Deprecated**: This field is now included as part of `feature_data` under the `Retry` variant.|
|» unified_code|body|string \| null|false|error code unified across the connectors|
|» unified_message|body|string \| null|false|error message unified across the connectors|
|» error_category|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» clear_pan_possible|body|boolean|true|**Deprecated.** indicates if retry with pan is possible<br>**Deprecated**: This field is now included as part of `feature_data` under the `Retry` variant.|
|» feature|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» feature_data|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » retry|body|[RetryFeatureData](#schemaretryfeaturedata)|true|Represents the data associated with a retry feature in GSM.|
|» standardised_code|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|A detailed description of the error intended for debugging, analytics, and support teams.|
|» user_guidance_message|body|string \| null|false|A user-friendly message that can be safely displayed to the customer.<br>This message provides guidance on what the user should do to<br>resolve the issue.|

```json
  "standardised_code": {},
  "description": "string",
  "user_guidance_message": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="gsm---update-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[GsmUpdateRequest](#schemagsmupdaterequest)|true|none|
|» connector|body|string|true|The connector through which payment has gone through|
|» flow|body|string|true|The flow in which the code and message occurred for a connector|
|» sub_flow|body|string|true|The sub_flow in which the code and message occurred  for a connector|
|» code|body|string|true|code received from the connector|
|» message|body|string|true|message received from the connector|
|» status|body|string \| null|false|status provided by the router|
|» router_error|body|string \| null|false|optional error provided by the router|
|» decision|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» step_up_possible|body|boolean \| null|false|**Deprecated.** indicates if step_up retry is possible<br>**Deprecated**: This field is now included as part of `feature_data` under the `Retry` variant.|
|» unified_code|body|string \| null|false|error code unified across the connectors|
|» unified_message|body|string \| null|false|error message unified across the connectors|
|» error_category|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» clear_pan_possible|body|boolean \| null|false|**Deprecated.** indicates if retry with pan is possible<br>**Deprecated**: This field is now included as part of `feature_data` under the `Retry` variant.|
|» feature|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» feature_data|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » retry|body|[RetryFeatureData](#schemaretryfeaturedata)|true|Represents the data associated with a retry feature in GSM.|
|» standardised_code|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|A detailed description of the error intended for debugging, analytics, and support teams.|
|» user_guidance_message|body|string \| null|false|A user-friendly message that can be safely displayed to the customer.<br>This message provides guidance on what the user should do to<br>resolve the issue.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
  "connector": "string",
  "flow": "string",
  "sub_flow": "string",
  "code": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "status": "string",
  "router_error": "string",
  "decision": "retry",
  "step_up_possible": true,
  "unified_code": "string",
  "unified_message": "string",

    }
  },

  "description": "string",
  "user_guidance_message": "string"
}
```

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-blocklist">Blocklist</h1>

## List Blocked fingerprints of a particular kind

<a id="opIdList Blocked fingerprints of a particular kind"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/blocklist?data_kind=payment_method' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /blocklist`

<h3 id="list-blocked-fingerprints-of-a-particular-kind-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data_kind|query|[BlocklistDataKind](#schemablocklistdatakind)|true|Kind of the fingerprint list requested|
|transaction_type|query|object \| null|false|Blocklist flow: payment (default) or payout.|
|X-Profile-Id|header|string \| null|false|Restricts the listing to entries belonging to this business profile, plus entries with no profile. When no profile can be resolved - as with publishable-key authentication - all of the merchant's entries are returned, as before.|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|data_kind|payment_method|
|data_kind|card_bin|
|data_kind|extended_card_bin|
|data_kind|generic_card_bin|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "fingerprint_id": "string",
  "data_kind": "payment_method",
  "transaction_type": "payment",
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "profile_id": "pro_abcdefghijklmnop"
}
```

<h3 id="list-blocked-fingerprints-of-a-particular-kind-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Blocked Fingerprints|[BlocklistResponse](#schemablocklistresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid Data|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key, jwt_key, publishable_key
</aside>

## Block a Fingerprint

<a id="opIdBlock a Fingerprint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/blocklist \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "type": "card_bin",
    "data": "string",
    "transaction_type": "payment"
  }'
```

`POST /blocklist`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "type": "card_bin",
  "data": "string",
  "transaction_type": "payment"
}
```

<h3 id="block-a-fingerprint-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Profile-Id|header|string \| null|false|The business profile to block this entry under. Ignored when authenticating with a JWT, which carries its own profile. If omitted, the merchant's default profile is used; merchants with more than one profile have no default and will receive an error asking for this header.|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|
|body|body|[BlocklistEntryRequest](#schemablocklistentryrequest)|true|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» type|body|string|true|none|
|» data|body|string|true|**Deprecated.** Deprecated, use `generic_card_bin`. A card number prefix of exactly 6 digits.|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» type|body|string|true|none|
|» data|body|string|true|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» type|body|string|true|none|
|» data|body|string|true|**Deprecated.** Deprecated, use `generic_card_bin`. A card number prefix of exactly 8 digits.|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» type|body|string|true|none|
|» data|body|string|true|A card number prefix of 6 to 10 digits.|
|» transaction_type|body|[BlocklistTransactionType](#schemablocklisttransactiontype)|false|The transaction namespace of a blocklist entry, stored as text.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|card_bin|
|» type|fingerprint|
|» type|extended_card_bin|
|» type|generic_card_bin|
|» transaction_type|payment|
|» transaction_type|payout|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "fingerprint_id": "string",
  "data_kind": "payment_method",
  "transaction_type": "payment",
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "profile_id": "pro_abcdefghijklmnop"
}
```

<h3 id="block-a-fingerprint-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

</aside>

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/blocklist \
```

|» data|body|string|true|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» type|body|string|true|none|
|» data|body|string|true|**Deprecated.** Deprecated, use `generic_card_bin`. A card number prefix of exactly 8 digits.|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» type|body|string|true|none|
|» data|body|string|true|A card number prefix of 6 to 10 digits.|
|» transaction_type|body|[BlocklistTransactionType](#schemablocklisttransactiontype)|false|The transaction namespace of a blocklist entry, stored as text.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|card_bin|
|» type|fingerprint|

|» type|generic_card_bin|

|» transaction_type|payout|

## Look up whether a value is blocked

<a id="opIdLook up whether a value is blocked"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/blocklist/lookup?data=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /blocklist/lookup`

<h3 id="look-up-whether-a-value-is-blocked-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|query|string|true|The raw value to check against the blocklist, e.g. a card BIN|
|transaction_type|query|object \| null|false|Looks up only payment or payout when selected. When omitted, both are included. Legacy NULL transaction namespaces belong to payment.|
|X-Profile-Id|header|string \| null|false|Restricts the lookup to entries belonging to this business profile, plus entries with no profile. If omitted, the merchant's default profile is used; merchants with more than one profile have no default and will receive an error asking for this header.|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "data": "string",
  "blocked": true,
  "transaction_types": [
    "payment"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="look-up-whether-a-value-is-blocked-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|All matches within the resolved profile, including merchant-wide entries. transaction_types contains distinct matching payment/payout namespaces, without data kinds or profile IDs.|[BlocklistLookupResponse](#schemablocklistlookupresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid Data, or no profile could be resolved|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key, jwt_key
</aside>

## List batch blocklist jobs

<a id="opIdList batch blocklist jobs"></a>

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/blocklist/batch \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
```

`GET /blocklist/batch`

<h3 id="list-batch-blocklist-jobs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Maximum number of jobs to return (default 10, max 100)|
|offset|query|integer(int32) \| null|false|Zero-based offset for pagination (default 0)|
|job_type|query|object \| null|false|Restricts the listing to `upload`, `export`, or `profile_clone` jobs. All kinds are returned when omitted, newest first.|
|X-Profile-Id|header|string \| null|false|Restricts the listing to jobs run for this business profile, plus jobs that predate profile scoping. When no profile can be resolved, all of the merchant's jobs are returned, as before.|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "count": 0,
  "total_count": 0,
  "data": [
    {
      "job_id": "string",
      "merchant_id": "string",
      "profile_id": "pro_abcdefghijklmnop",
      "job_type": "upload",
      "file_name": "string",
      "status": "initiated",
      "total_rows": 0,
      "succeeded_rows": 0,
      "failed_rows": 0,
      "metadata": {
        "targets": [
          {
            "profile_id": "pro_abcdefghijklmnop",
            "status": "initiated",
            "processed_rows": 0,
            "error_message": "string"
          }
        ]
      },
      "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "updated_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "downloadable": true,
      "error_message": "string",
      "download_url": "string",
      "download_url_expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

## Upload a batch blocklist CSV

<a id="opIdUpload a batch blocklist CSV"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/blocklist/batch \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /blocklist/batch`

> Body parameter

```yaml
string
```

<h3 id="upload-a-batch-blocklist-csv-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|transaction_type|query|object \| null|false|Overrides every CSV row with payment or payout when selected. When omitted, row selections are used; missing or empty row values default to payment.|
|X-Profile-Id|header|string \| null|false|The business profile every entry in this upload is blocked under. Resolution follows the same rules as blocking a single entry.|
|X-Connected-Merchant-Id|header|string \| null|false|Merchant ID of the connected merchant on whose behalf the operation is performed. Required when authenticating with a platform merchant's API key. Standard and connected merchants must not send it.|
|body|body|string|true|A multipart/form-data request with a `file` field containing a UTF-8 CSV (max 5 MiB). The part's `filename` is recorded on the job and returned as `file_name`. The CSV header is `type,data,metadata,transaction_type`; older headers without `transaction_type` are accepted. `type`: one of `generic_card_bin` (6 to 10 digits), `card_bin` (6 digits), `extended_card_bin` (8 digits), `fingerprint`. `metadata`: optional, `key=value` pairs separated by `;` (e.g. `reason=fraud;source=manual`). `transaction_type`: optional, `payment` (default) or `payout`; selection may differ per row. Invalid CSV transaction-type values are rejected even when a query override is selected. Maximum 100,000 data rows.|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
{
  "job_id": "string",
  "total_rows": 0,
  "status": "initiated"
}
```

<h3 id="upload-a-batch-blocklist-csv-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Batch blocklist job initiated|[BatchBlocklistUploadResponse](#schemabatchblocklistuploadresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|CSV validation error, file exceeds 5 MiB limit, or no profile could be resolved|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key, jwt_key
</aside>

## Blocklist - Clone Entries

<a id="opIdClone blocklist entries across profiles"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/blocklist/clone \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "api-key: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "target_profile_ids": [
      "string"
    ],
    "transaction_type": {}
  }'
```

`POST /blocklist/clone`

Copies a business profile's blocklist entries onto other profiles of the same merchant. The
copy runs as one background job whose process tracker clones onto the targets one at a time.
Poll `/blocklist/batch/{job_id}` for per-target progress in the job metadata.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "target_profile_ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "transaction_type": {}
}
```

<h3 id="blocklist---clone-entries-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-Profile-Id|header|string \| null|false|Source profile whose entries are copied; it also owns the clone job. Required when the authenticated dashboard session does not provide a profile context|
|body|body|[CloneBlocklistEntriesRequest](#schemacloneblocklistentriesrequest)|true|none|
|» target_profile_ids|body|[string]|true|none|
|» transaction_type|body|object \| null|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "source_profile_id": "pro_abcdefghijklmnop",
  "job_id": "string",
  "status": "initiated",
  "target_profile_ids": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="blocklist---clone-entries-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|One background job was started; it clones onto the target profiles one at a time|[CloneBlocklistEntriesResponse](#schemacloneblocklistentriesresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Missing profile context, no targets given, or a target is the source profile|None|
|404|Not Found|The source or a target profile does not belong to the merchant|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
api_key, jwt_key
</aside>

<h1 id="hyperswitch---api-documentation-platform">Platform</h1>

## Platform - Create

<a id="opIdCreate a Platform Account"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io/user/create_platform \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "organization_name": "organization_abc"
  }'
```

`POST /user/create_platform`

Create a new platform account

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "organization_name": "organization_abc"
}
```

<h3 id="platform---create-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[PlatformAccountCreateRequest](#schemaplatformaccountcreaterequest)|true|Create a platform account with organization_name|
|» organization_name|body|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "merchant_account_type": "platform",
  "merchant_id": "merchant_abc",
  "org_id": "org_abc",
  "org_name": "organization_abc",
  "org_type": "platform"
}
```

<h3 id="platform---create-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Platform Account Created|[PlatformAccountCreateResponse](#schemaplatformaccountcreateresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid data|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
jwt_key
</aside>

<h2 id="tocS_AuthenticationType">AuthenticationType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaauthenticationtype"></a>
<a id="schema_AuthenticationType"></a>
<a id="tocSauthenticationtype"></a>
<a id="tocsauthenticationtype"></a>

```json
"three_ds"
```

Specifies the type of cardholder authentication to be applied for a payment.

- `ThreeDs`: Requests 3D Secure (3DS) authentication. If the card is enrolled, 3DS authentication will be activated, potentially shifting chargeback liability to the issuer.
- `NoThreeDs`: Indicates that 3D Secure authentication should not be performed. The liability for chargebacks typically remains with the merchant. This is often the default if not specified.

Note: The actual authentication behavior can also be influenced by merchant configuration and specific connector defaults. Some connectors might still enforce 3DS or bypass it regardless of this parameter.

```json
{
```


One batch blocklist job, as returned by the listing and by `GET /blocklist/batch/{job_id}`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|job_id|string|true|none|none|
|merchant_id|string|true|none|none|
|profile_id|string \| null|false|none|The profile that owns this job; for a clone job, the profile whose entries are copied.|
|job_type|[BatchBlocklistJobType](#schemabatchblocklistjobtype)|true|none|Distinguishes bulk upload, CSV export, and profile clone jobs.|
|file_name|string \| null|false|none|The file the merchant uploaded, or the name the export downloads as. Clone jobs return<br>`null`.|
|status|[BatchBlocklistJobStatus](#schemabatchblocklistjobstatus)|true|none|none|
|total_rows|integer(int32)|true|none|none|
|succeeded_rows|integer(int32)|true|none|none|
|failed_rows|integer(int32)|true|none|none|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|expires_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Exports only: when the stored file is removed by the storage lifecycle rule.|
|downloadable|boolean|true|none|Whether this job's file can be fetched right now.|
|error_message|string \| null|false|none|none|
|download_url|string \| null|false|none|Exports only: short-lived signed link, generated per request and never stored. Null in the<br>listing, which does not mint a link per row.|
|download_url_expires_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|job_type|upload|
|job_type|export|
|job_type|profile_clone|
|status|initiated|
|status|processing|
|status|completed|
|status|failed|

```json
}
```

Response payload returned after successfully cancelling a subscription.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|id|[SubscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid)|true|none|A type for subscription_id that can be used for subscription ids|
|status|[SubscriptionStatus](#schemasubscriptionstatus)|true|none|Possible states of a subscription lifecycle.<br><br>- `Created`: Subscription was created but not yet activated.<br>- `Active`: Subscription is currently active.<br>- `InActive`: Subscription is inactive.<br>- `Pending`: Subscription is pending activation.<br>- `Trial`: Subscription is in a trial period.<br>- `Paused`: Subscription is paused.<br>- `Unpaid`: Subscription is unpaid.<br>- `Onetime`: Subscription is a one-time payment.<br>- `Cancelled`: Subscription has been cancelled.<br>- `Failed`: Subscription has failed.|
|merchant_reference_id|string \| null|false|none|Merchant specific Unique identifier.|
|profile_id|[ProfileId](#schemaprofileid)|true|none|A type for profile_id that can be used for business profile ids|
|merchant_id|[MerchantId](#schemamerchantid)|true|none|A type for merchant_id that can be used for merchant ids|
|customer_id|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid)|true|none|A type for customer_id that can be used for customer ids|
|cancelled_at|string \| null|false|none|Date when the subscription was cancelled|

<h2 id="tocS_CaptureMethod">CaptureMethod</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacapturemethod"></a>
<a id="schema_CaptureMethod"></a>
<a id="tocScapturemethod"></a>
<a id="tocscapturemethod"></a>

```json
"automatic"
```

Specifies how the payment is captured.
- `automatic`: Funds are captured immediately after successful authorization. This is the default behavior if the field is omitted.
- `manual`: Funds are authorized but not captured. A separate request to the `/payments/{payment_id}/capture` endpoint is required to capture the funds.

```json
{
  "capture_id": "string",
  "status": "started",
  "amount": 6540,
  "currency": {},
  "connector": "string",
  "authorized_attempt_id": "string",
  "connector_capture_id": "string",
  "capture_sequence": 0,
  "error_message": "string",
  "error_code": "string",
  "error_reason": "string",
  "reference_id": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|capture_id|string|true|none|A unique identifier for this specific capture operation.|
|status|[CaptureStatus](#schemacapturestatus)|true|none|none|
|amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The capture amount. Amount for the payment in lowest denomination of the currency. (i.e) in cents for USD denomination, in paisa for INR denomination etc.,|
|currency|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector|string|true|none|The name of the payment connector that processed this capture.|
|authorized_attempt_id|string|true|none|The ID of the payment attempt that was successfully authorized and subsequently captured by this operation.|
|connector_capture_id|string \| null|false|none|A unique identifier for this capture provided by the connector|
|capture_sequence|integer(int32)|true|none|Sequence number of this capture, in the series of captures made for the parent attempt|
|error_message|string \| null|false|none|A human-readable message from the connector explaining why this capture operation failed, if applicable.|
|error_code|string \| null|false|none|The error code returned by the connector if this capture operation failed. This code is connector-specific.|
|error_reason|string \| null|false|none|A more detailed reason from the connector explaining the capture failure, if available.|
|reference_id|string \| null|false|none|The connector's own reference or transaction ID for this specific capture operation. Useful for reconciliation.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

```json
    "type": "number",

  "metadata": {
    "property1": null,

  }
```

Represents a single comparison condition.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lhs|string|true|none|The left hand side which will always be a domain input identifier like "payment.method.cardtype"|
|comparison|[ComparisonType](#schemacomparisontype)|true|none|Conditional comparison type|
|value|[ValueType](#schemavaluetype)|true|none|Represents a value in the DSL|
|metadata|object|true|none|Additional metadata that the Static Analyzer and Backend does not touch.<br>This can be used to store useful information for the frontend and is required for communication<br>between the static analyzer and the frontend.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

A saved customer payment method as returned in the client-facing PM list.

This is a slimmed-down version of `CustomerPaymentMethod` intended for the
`GET /payments/{payment_id}/payment-methods/client` endpoint.  Fields that are
Only the fields needed by the SDK are included; server-side fields
(e.g. `surcharge_details`, `metadata`) are omitted.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_token|string|true|none|Token for payment method in temporary card locker which gets refreshed often.<br>The SDK passes this back when submitting the payment.|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|Indicates the type of payment method. Eg: 'card', 'wallet', etc.|
|payment_method_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|default_payment_method_set|boolean|true|none|Whether this is the customer's default payment method|
|requires_cvv|boolean|true|none|Whether CVV collection is required before using this method|
|created|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the payment method was saved|
|last_used_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When this payment method was last used for a payment|
|recurring_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether this payment method supports recurring / off-session payments|
|payment_method_data|object \| null|false|none|none|

```json
{
  "created_after": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "created_before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "limit": 0,
  "offset": 0,
  "object_id": "string",
  "event_id": "string",
  "profile_id": "string",
  "event_classes": [
    "payments"
  ],
  "event_types": [
    "payment_succeeded"
  ],
  "is_delivered": true,
  "recipient": {}
}
```

The constraints to apply when filtering events.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created_after|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Filter events created after the specified time.|
|created_before|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Filter events created before the specified time.|
|limit|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Include at most the specified number of events.|
|offset|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Include events after the specified offset.|
|object_id|string \| null|false|none|Filter all events associated with the specified object identifier (Payment Intent ID,<br>Refund ID, etc.)|
|event_id|string \| null|false|none|Filter all events associated with the specified Event_id|
|profile_id|string \| null|false|none|Filter all events associated with the specified business profile ID.|
|event_classes|[[EventClass](#schemaeventclass)]|false|none|Filter events by their class.|
|event_types|[[EventType](#schemaeventtype)]|false|none|Filter events by their type.|
|is_delivered|boolean \| null|false|none|Filter all events by `is_overall_delivery_successful` field of the event.|
|recipient|object \| null|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_FutureUsage">FutureUsage</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemafutureusage"></a>
<a id="schema_FutureUsage"></a>
<a id="tocSfutureusage"></a>
<a id="tocsfutureusage"></a>

```json
"off_session"
```

Specifies how the payment method can be used for future payments.
- `off_session`: The payment method can be used for future payments when the customer is not present.
- `on_session`: The payment method is intended for use only when the customer is present during checkout.

If omitted, defaults to `on_session`.

<a id="schemagooglepaytokenizationspecificationtype"></a>
<a id="schema_GooglePayTokenizationSpecificationType"></a>
<a id="tocSgooglepaytokenizationspecificationtype"></a>
<a id="tocsgooglepaytokenizationspecificationtype"></a>

```json
"PAYMENT_GATEWAY"
```

The tokenization type sent to the Google Pay SDK.

Unlike [`GooglePayTokenizationType`], this holds only the values Google itself understands:
the Hyperswitch-internal `INTERNAL_GATEWAY` marker is resolved into `PAYMENT_GATEWAY` during
the session flow before this is built, so it can never leak into an SDK response.

<h2 id="tocS_GooglePayWalletData">GooglePayWalletData</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagooglepaywalletdata"></a>
<a id="schema_GooglePayWalletData"></a>
<a id="tocSgooglepaywalletdata"></a>
<a id="tocsgooglepaywalletdata"></a>

```json
{
  "type": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "info": {
    "card_network": "string",
    "card_details": "string",
    "assurance_details": {
      "card_holder_authenticated": true,
      "account_verified": true
    },
    "card_funding_source": {}
  },
  "tokenization_data": {
    "auth_method": {},
    "card_exp_month": "string",
    "card_exp_year": "string",
    "application_primary_account_number": "4242424242424242",
    "cryptogram": "AgAAAAAAAIR8CQrXcIhbQAAAAAA",
    "eci_indicator": "07"
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|The type of payment method|
|description|string|true|none|User-facing message to describe the payment method that funds this transaction.|
|info|[GooglePayPaymentMethodInfo](#schemagooglepaypaymentmethodinfo)|true|none|none|
|tokenization_data|[GpayTokenizationData](#schemagpaytokenizationdata)|true|none|This enum is used to represent the Gpay payment data, which can either be encrypted or decrypted.|

<h2 id="tocS_GpayAllowedMethodsParameters">GpayAllowedMethodsParameters</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagpayallowedmethodsparameters"></a>
<a id="schema_GpayAllowedMethodsParameters"></a>
<a id="tocSgpayallowedmethodsparameters"></a>
<a id="tocsgpayallowedmethodsparameters"></a>

```json
{
  "allowed_auth_methods": [
    "string"
  ],
  "allowed_card_networks": [
    "string"
  ],
  "billing_address_required": true,
  "billing_address_parameters": {
    "phone_number_required": true,
    "format": "FULL"
  },
  "assurance_details_required": true,
  "allow_credit_cards": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allowed_auth_methods|[string]|true|none|The list of allowed auth methods (ex: 3DS, No3DS, PAN_ONLY etc)|
|allowed_card_networks|[string]|true|none|The list of allowed card networks (ex: AMEX,JCB etc)|
|billing_address_required|boolean \| null|false|none|Is billing address required|
|billing_address_parameters|object \| null|false|none|none|
|assurance_details_required|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether assurance details are required|
|allow_credit_cards|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to false if you don't want to allow credit cards|

```json
}
```

Create a new Merchant Connector for the merchant account. The connector could be a payment processor / facilitator / acquirer or specialized services like Fraud / Accounting etc."

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|connector_type|[ConnectorType](#schemaconnectortype)|true|none|Type of the Connector for the financial use case. Could range from Payments to Accounting to Banking.|
|connector_label|string \| null|false|none|This is an unique label you can generate and pass in order to identify this connector account on your Hyperswitch dashboard and reports. Eg: if your profile label is `default`, connector label can be `stripe_default`|
|connector_account_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_methods_enabled|[[PaymentMethodsEnabled](#schemapaymentmethodsenabled)]|false|none|An object containing the details about the payment methods that need to be enabled under this merchant connector account|
|connector_webhook_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Metadata is useful for storing additional, unstructured information on an object.|
|test_mode|boolean \| null|false|none|A boolean value to indicate if the connector is in Test mode. By default, its value is false.|
|disabled|boolean \| null|false|none|A boolean value to indicate if the connector is disabled. By default, its value is false.|
|frm_configs|[[FrmConfigs](#schemafrmconfigs)]|false|none|Contains the frm configs for the merchant connector|
|pm_auth_config|object \| null|false|none|pm_auth_config will relate MCA records to their respective chosen auth services, based on payment_method and pmt|
|status|[ConnectorStatus](#schemaconnectorstatus)|true|none|none|
|additional_merchant_data|object \| null|false|none|none|

```json
      "merchant_connector_id": "string"
    }
  },
  "created_at": 1718000000000,
  "modified_at": 1718050000000,
  "algorithm_for": "payment"
}
```

Routing algorithm configuration created for a merchant.

Represents a fully defined routing strategy scoped to a profile
and transaction type.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier of the routing configuration.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"routing_abc123"<br>```|
|profile_id|string|true|none|Profile ID to which this routing configuration belongs.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"profile_123"<br>```|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name of the routing configuration.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"default_card_routing"<br>```|
|description|string|true|none|Description explaining the purpose of this routing configuration.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"Primary routing strategy for card payments"<br>```|
|algorithm|[RoutingAlgorithmWrapper](#schemaroutingalgorithmwrapper)|true|none|none|
|created_at|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp (in milliseconds since epoch) when the routing<br>configuration was created.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>1718000000000<br>```|
|modified_at|integer(int64)|true|none|Timestamp (in milliseconds since epoch) when the routing<br>configuration was last modified.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>1718050000000<br>```|
|algorithm_for|[TransactionType](#schematransactiontype)|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|algorithm_for|payment|
|algorithm_for|payout|
|algorithm_for|three_ds_authentication|

<h2 id="tocS_MultiCurrencyProcessingData">MultiCurrencyProcessingData</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemamulticurrencyprocessingdata"></a>
<a id="schema_MultiCurrencyProcessingData"></a>
<a id="tocSmulticurrencyprocessingdata"></a>
<a id="tocsmulticurrencyprocessingdata"></a>

```json
{
  "currency": "AED",
  "amount": 0,
  "conversion_rate": 0,
  "date": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "processing_reference_id": "string",
  "user_id": "string",
  "conversion_provider": "string",
  "conversion_reason_code": "string"
}
```

Datatrans multi-currency processing (multi-currency processing) details supplied by the merchant.

`amount`/`currency` here describe the **merchant settlement leg** — what Planet pays out to
the merchant. The payment's own `amount`/`currency` remain the **customer-facing leg**, i.e.
what the shopper saw at checkout and is charged. Hyperswitch never recomputes either leg; the
merchant is the source of truth for both.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "USD", "EUR") for the payment amount. This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The merchant settlement amount, expressed in `currency`. The merchant converts the<br>customer-facing amount itself and supplies the result here.|
|conversion_rate|number(double) \| null|false|none|Conversion rate received from the currency rates endpoint. Required for dynamic multi-currency processing.|
|date|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Transaction datetime received from the currency rates endpoint.|
|processing_reference_id|string \| null|false|none|Processing reference received from the currency rates endpoint.|
|user_id|string \| null|false|none|none|
|conversion_provider|string \| null|false|none|The provider for multi-currency processing.|
|conversion_reason_code|string \| null|false|none|Reason indicator received from the acquirer.|

|content|[OutgoingWebhookContent](#schemaoutgoingwebhookcontent)|true|none|none|
|timestamp|string(date-time)|false|none|The time at which webhook was sent|
|processor_merchant_id|string \| null|false|none|The merchant id of the merchant account whose connector credentials are used for payment processing|

|merchant_id|[MerchantId](#schemamerchantid)|true|none|A type for merchant_id that can be used for merchant ids|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attempt_id|string|true|none|A unique identifier for this specific payment attempt.|
|status|[AttemptStatus](#schemaattemptstatus)|true|none|The status of the attempt|
|amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The payment attempt amount. Amount for the payment in lowest denomination of the currency. (i.e) in cents for USD denomination, in paisa for INR denomination etc.,|

|payment_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector_transaction_id|string \| null|false|none|A unique identifier for a payment provided by the connector|
|capture_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|authentication_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Time at which the payment attempt was created|
|modified_at|string(date-time)|true|none|Time at which the payment attempt was last modified|
|cancellation_reason|string \| null|false|none|If the payment was cancelled the reason will be provided here|
|mandate_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** If this payment attempt is associated with a mandate (e.g., for a recurring or subsequent payment), this field will contain the ID of that mandate.|
|error_code|string \| null|false|none|The error code returned by the connector if this payment attempt failed. This code is specific to the connector.|
|payment_token|string \| null|false|none|If a tokenized (saved) payment method was used for this attempt, this field contains the payment token representing that payment method.|
|connector_metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional data related to some connectors|
|payment_experience|object \| null|false|none|none|

The combined payment-method list, or the error that prevented it being built.

Serialized untagged: a success is the listing object itself, a failure is `{ "error": {...} }`.
Gated on `errors` as well as `v1`: it holds [`crate::errors::types::ErrorResponse`], which
lives behind that feature because it pulls in `reqwest`. `euclid_wasm` builds
`api_models/v1` without `errors`, and cannot take `actix-web` in via that feature on a
wasm target, so the section types simply do not exist there.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[ClientPaymentMethodsListResponse](#schemaclientpaymentmethodslistresponse)|false|none|Response for the GET /payments/{payment_id}/payment-methods/client endpoint|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|Serializes as `{ "error": { ... } }` — the same envelope the HTTP layer puts around<br>`ErrorResponse`, so this reads identically to the standalone endpoint's error body.|
|error|[GenericErrorResponseOpenApi](#schemagenericerrorresponseopenapi)|true|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_PaymentMethodTokenizationDetails">PaymentMethodTokenizationDetails</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapaymentmethodtokenizationdetails"></a>
<a id="schema_PaymentMethodTokenizationDetails"></a>
<a id="tocSpaymentmethodtokenizationdetails"></a>
<a id="tocspaymentmethodtokenizationdetails"></a>

```json
{
  "payment_method_id": "string",
  "payment_method_status": {},
  "psp_tokenization": true,
  "network_tokenization": true,
  "network_transaction_id": "string",
  "network_transaction_link_id": "string",
  "is_eligible_for_mit_payment": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_method_id|string|true|none|The unique identifier for the payment method|
|payment_method_status|object \| null|false|none|none|
|psp_tokenization|boolean|true|none|This indicates whether there is at least one active PSP token available|
|network_tokenization|boolean|true|none|This indicates whether a payment method is tokenized with card network|
|network_transaction_id|string \| null|false|none|This is the transaction id generated by the network|
|network_transaction_link_id|string \| null|false|none|The Mastercard Transaction Link Identifier (TLID) stored on the saved payment method.|
|is_eligible_for_mit_payment|boolean|true|none|This indicates whether a payment method is eligible for performing a mit transaction|

<h2 id="tocS_PaymentMethodType">PaymentMethodType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapaymentmethodtype"></a>
<a id="schema_PaymentMethodType"></a>
<a id="tocSpaymentmethodtype"></a>
<a id="tocspaymentmethodtype"></a>

```json
"ach"
```

Indicates the sub type of payment method. Eg: 'google_pay' & 'apple_pay' for wallets.

<h2 id="tocS_PaymentMethodUpdate">PaymentMethodUpdate</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapaymentmethodupdate"></a>
<a id="schema_PaymentMethodUpdate"></a>

<a id="tocspaymentmethodupdate"></a>

```json
{
  "update_last_used_at": true,
  "card": {
    "card_exp_month": "10",
    "card_exp_year": "25",
    "card_holder_name": "John Doe",
    "nick_name": "John Doe",
    "last4_digits": "1111",
    "card_issuer": "Bank of America",
    "issuer_country": "US",
    "issuer_country_code": "US",
    "card_network": "VISA"
  },
  "wallet": {
    "last4": "string",
    "card_network": "string",
    "type": "string",
    "card_exp_month": "10",
    "card_exp_year": "25",
    "auth_code": "003225",
    "email": "johntest@test.com",
    "provider_details": {
      "PayPal": {
        "payer_id": "7DY7FRMPQ8CT6"
      }
    }
  },
  "client_secret": "secret_k2uj3he2893eiu2d"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|update_last_used_at|boolean \| null|false|none|none|
|card|object \| null|false|none|none|
|wallet|object \| null|false|none|none|
|client_secret|string \| null|false|none|This is a 15 minute expiry token which shall be used from the client to authenticate and perform sessions from the SDK|

<h2 id="tocS_PaymentMethodsConfig">PaymentMethodsConfig</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapaymentmethodsconfig"></a>
<a id="schema_PaymentMethodsConfig"></a>
<a id="tocSpaymentmethodsconfig"></a>
<a id="tocspaymentmethodsconfig"></a>

```json
[
  {
    "payment_method": "card",
    "payment_method_types": [
      {
        "message": {
          "display_mode": "custom",
          "value": "Sample message"
        },
        "payment_method_type": "credit"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

List of custom T&C messages grouped by payment method

<h2 id="tocS_PaymentMethodsEnabled">PaymentMethodsEnabled</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapaymentmethodsenabled"></a>
<a id="schema_PaymentMethodsEnabled"></a>
<a id="tocSpaymentmethodsenabled"></a>
<a id="tocspaymentmethodsenabled"></a>

```json
{
  "payment_method": "card",
  "payment_method_types": [
    "credit"
  ]
}
```

Details of all the payment methods enabled for the connector for the given merchant account

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|Indicates the type of payment method. Eg: 'card', 'wallet', etc.|
|payment_method_types|[[RequestPaymentMethodTypes](#schemarequestpaymentmethodtypes)]|false|none|Subtype of payment method|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|payment_method|card|
|payment_method|card_redirect|
|payment_method|pay_later|
|payment_method|wallet|
|payment_method|bank_redirect|
|payment_method|bank_transfer|
|payment_method|crypto|
|payment_method|bank_debit|
|payment_method|reward|
|payment_method|real_time_payment|

|statement_descriptor_prefix|string \| null|false|none|An optional prefix for the statement descriptor that appears on your customer's credit card statement. This can override the default prefix set on your merchant account. The combined length of prefix and suffix should not exceed connector-specific limits (typically 22 characters).|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The primary amount for the payment, provided in the lowest denomination of the specified currency (e.g., 6540 for $65.40 USD). This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|order_tax_amount|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Total tax amount applicable to the order, in the lowest denomination of the currency.|
|currency|object \| null|false|none|none|
|amount_to_capture|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The amount to be captured from the user's payment method, in the lowest denomination. If not provided, and `capture_method` is `automatic`, the full payment `amount` will be captured. If `capture_method` is `manual`, this can be specified in the `/capture` call. Must be less than or equal to the authorized amount.|
|shipping_cost|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The shipping cost for the payment. This is required for tax calculation in some regions.|
|payment_id|string \| null|false|none|Optional. A merchant-provided unique identifier for the payment, contains 30 characters long (e.g., "pay_mbabizu24mvu3mela5njyhpit4"). If provided, it ensures idempotency for the payment creation request. If omitted, Hyperswitch generates a unique ID for the payment.|
|routing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector|[[Connector](#schemaconnector)]|false|none|This allows to manually select a connector with which the payment can go through.|
|capture_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|authentication_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|billing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|confirm|boolean \| null|false|none|If set to `true`, Hyperswitch attempts to confirm and authorize the payment immediately after creation, provided sufficient payment method details are included. If `false` or omitted (default is `false`), the payment is created with a status such as `requires_payment_method` or `requires_confirmation`, and a separate `POST /payments/{payment_id}/confirm` call is necessary to proceed with authorization.|
|customer|object \| null|false|none|none|
|customer_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The identifier for the customer|
|off_session|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to true to indicate that the customer is not in your checkout flow during this payment, and therefore is unable to authenticate. This parameter is intended for scenarios where you collect card details and charge them later. When making a recurring payment by passing a mandate_id, this parameter is mandatory|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An arbitrary string attached to the payment. Often useful for displaying to users or for your own internal record-keeping.|
|return_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL to redirect the customer to after they complete the payment process or authentication. This is crucial for flows that involve off-site redirection (e.g., 3DS, some bank redirects, wallet payments).|
|setup_future_usage|object \| null|false|none|none|

|payment_method|object \| null|false|none|none|

|shipping|object \| null|false|none|none|
|statement_descriptor_name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** For non-card charges, you can use this value as the complete description that appears on your customers’ statements. Must contain at least one letter, maximum 22 characters. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|
|statement_descriptor_suffix|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Provides information about a card payment that customers see on their statements. Concatenated with the prefix (shortened descriptor) or statement descriptor that’s set on the account to form the complete statement descriptor. Maximum 22 characters for the concatenated descriptor. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|
|order_details|[[OrderDetailsWithAmount](#schemaorderdetailswithamount)]|false|none|Use this object to capture the details about the different products for which the payment is being made. The sum of amount across different products here should be equal to the overall payment amount|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The primary amount for the payment, provided in the lowest denomination of the specified currency (e.g., 6540 for $65.40 USD). This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|order_tax_amount|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Total tax amount applicable to the order, in the lowest denomination of the currency.|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "USD", "EUR") for the payment amount. This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|amount_to_capture|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The amount to be captured from the user's payment method, in the lowest denomination. If not provided, and `capture_method` is `automatic`, the full payment `amount` will be captured. If `capture_method` is `manual`, this can be specified in the `/capture` call. Must be less than or equal to the authorized amount.|
|shipping_cost|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The shipping cost for the payment. This is required for tax calculation in some regions.|
|payment_id|string \| null|false|none|Optional. A merchant-provided unique identifier for the payment, contains 30 characters long (e.g., "pay_mbabizu24mvu3mela5njyhpit4"). If provided, it ensures idempotency for the payment creation request. If omitted, Hyperswitch generates a unique ID for the payment.|
|routing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector|[[Connector](#schemaconnector)]|false|none|This allows to manually select a connector with which the payment can go through.|
|capture_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|authentication_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|billing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|confirm|boolean \| null|false|none|If set to `true`, Hyperswitch attempts to confirm and authorize the payment immediately after creation, provided sufficient payment method details are included. If `false` or omitted (default is `false`), the payment is created with a status such as `requires_payment_method` or `requires_confirmation`, and a separate `POST /payments/{payment_id}/confirm` call is necessary to proceed with authorization.|
|customer|object \| null|false|none|none|
|customer_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The identifier for the customer|
|off_session|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to true to indicate that the customer is not in your checkout flow during this payment, and therefore is unable to authenticate. This parameter is intended for scenarios where you collect card details and charge them later. When making a recurring payment by passing a mandate_id, this parameter is mandatory|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An arbitrary string attached to the payment. Often useful for displaying to users or for your own internal record-keeping.|
|return_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL to redirect the customer to after they complete the payment process or authentication. This is crucial for flows that involve off-site redirection (e.g., 3DS, some bank redirects, wallet payments).|
|setup_future_usage|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_token|string \| null|false|none|As Hyperswitch tokenises the sensitive details about the payments method, it provides the payment_token as a reference to a stored payment method, ensuring that the sensitive details are not exposed in any manner.|
|shipping|object \| null|false|none|none|
|statement_descriptor_name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** For non-card charges, you can use this value as the complete description that appears on your customers’ statements. Must contain at least one letter, maximum 22 characters. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|
|statement_descriptor_suffix|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Provides information about a card payment that customers see on their statements. Concatenated with the prefix (shortened descriptor) or statement descriptor that’s set on the account to form the complete statement descriptor. Maximum 22 characters for the concatenated descriptor. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|
|order_details|[[OrderDetailsWithAmount](#schemaorderdetailswithamount)]|false|none|Use this object to capture the details about the different products for which the payment is being made. The sum of amount across different products here should be equal to the overall payment amount|
|mandate_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|customer_acceptance|object \| null|false|none|none|
|mandate_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** A unique identifier to link the payment to a mandate. To do Recurring payments after a mandate has been created, pass the mandate_id instead of payment_method_data|
|browser_info|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_experience|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|business_country|object \| null|false|none|none|
|business_label|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Business label of the merchant for this payment.<br>To be deprecated soon. Pass the profile_id instead|
|merchant_connector_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|allowed_payment_method_types|[[PaymentMethodType](#schemapaymentmethodtype)]|false|none|Use this parameter to restrict the Payment Method Types to show for a given PaymentIntent|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|You can specify up to 50 keys, with key names up to 40 characters long and values up to 500 characters long. Metadata is useful for storing additional, structured information on an object.|
|connector_metadata|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_link|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether to generate the payment link for this payment or not (if applicable)|
|payment_link_config|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_link_config_id|string \| null|false|none|Custom payment link config id set at business profile, send only if business_specific_configs is configured|
|profile_id|string \| null|false|none|The business profile to be used for this payment, if not passed the default business profile associated with the merchant account will be used. It is mandatory in case multiple business profiles have been set up.|
|surcharge_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|offer_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|request_incremental_authorization|boolean \| null|false|none|Request an incremental authorization, i.e., increase the authorized amount on a confirmed payment before you capture it.|
|session_expiry|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Will be used to expire client secret after certain amount of time to be supplied in seconds<br>(900) for 15 mins|
|frm_metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional data related to some frm(Fraud Risk Management) connectors|
|request_external_three_ds_authentication|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether to perform external authentication (if applicable)|
|three_ds_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|recurring_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|split_payments|object \| null|false|none|none|
|request_extended_authorization|boolean \| null|false|none|Optional boolean value to extent authorization period of this payment<br><br>capture method must be manual or manual_multiple|
|merchant_order_reference_id|string \| null|false|none|Your unique identifier for this payment or order. This ID helps you reconcile payments on your system. If provided, it is passed to the connector if supported.|
|skip_external_tax_calculation|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether to calculate tax for this payment intent|
|psd2_sca_exemption_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|ctp_service_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|force_3ds_challenge|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if 3ds challenge is forced|
|threeds_method_comp_ind|object \| null|false|none|none|
|is_iframe_redirection_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if the redirection has to open in the iframe|
|all_keys_required|boolean \| null|false|none|If enabled, provides whole connector response|
|payment_channel|object \| null|false|none|none|
|tax_status|object \| null|false|none|none|
|discount_amount|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Total amount of the discount you have applied to the order or transaction.|
|shipping_amount_tax|object \| null|false|none|none|
|duty_amount|object \| null|false|none|none|
|order_date|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Date the payer placed the order.|
|enable_partial_authorization|boolean \| null|false|none|Allow partial authorization for this payment|
|enable_overcapture|boolean \| null|false|none|Boolean indicating whether to enable overcapture for this payment|
|is_stored_credential|boolean \| null|false|none|Boolean flag indicating whether this payment method is stored and has been previously used for payments|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the payment. This ensures idempotency for multiple payments<br>that have been done by a single merchant.|
|merchant_id|string|true|none|This is an identifier for the merchant account. This is inferred from the API key<br>provided during the request|
|status|object|true|none|none|
|amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The payment amount. Amount for the payment in lowest denomination of the currency. (i.e) in cents for USD denomination, in paisa for INR denomination etc.,|
|net_amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The payment net amount. net_amount = amount + surcharge_details.surcharge_amount + surcharge_details.tax_amount + shipping_cost + order_tax_amount,<br>If no surcharge_details, shipping_cost, order_tax_amount, net_amount = amount|
|shipping_cost|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The shipping cost for the payment.|
|amount_capturable|integer(int64)|true|none|The amount (in minor units) that can still be captured for this payment. This is relevant when `capture_method` is `manual`. Once fully captured, or if `capture_method` is `automatic` and payment succeeded, this will be 0.|
|amount_received|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The total amount (in minor units) that has been captured for this payment. For `fauxpay` sandbox connector, this might reflect the authorized amount if `status` is `succeeded` even if `capture_method` was `manual`.|
|processor_merchant_id|string|true|none|The identifier for the processor merchant account. In platform-connected setups,<br>this is the connected merchant ID. For standard merchants, this is same as merchant_id.|
|initiator|object \| null|false|none|none|
|sdk_authorization|string \| null|false|none|Token containing encoded information for sdk authorization.|
|payment_method_list|object \| null|false|none|none|
|session_tokens|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector|string \| null|false|none|The name of the payment connector (e.g., 'stripe', 'adyen') that processed or is processing this payment.|
|state_metadata|object \| null|false|none|none|
|client_secret|string \| null|false|none|A secret token unique to this payment intent. It is primarily used by client-side applications (e.g., Hyperswitch SDKs) to authenticate actions like confirming the payment or handling next actions. This secret should be handled carefully and not exposed publicly beyond its intended client-side use.|
|created|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Timestamp indicating when this payment intent was created, in ISO 8601 format.|
|modified_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Timestamp indicating when this payment intent was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.|
|connector_customer_id|string \| null|false|none|A unique identifier for a customer provided by the connector.|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "USD", "EUR") for the payment amount. This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|customer_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The identifier for the customer object. If not provided the customer ID will be autogenerated.<br>This field will be deprecated soon. Please refer to `customer.id`|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An arbitrary string providing a description for the payment, often useful for display or internal record-keeping.|
|refunds|[[RefundResponse](#schemarefundresponse)]|false|none|An array of refund objects associated with this payment. Empty or null if no refunds have been processed.|
|disputes|[[DisputeResponsePaymentsRetrieve](#schemadisputeresponsepaymentsretrieve)]|false|none|List of disputes that happened on this intent|
|attempts|[[PaymentAttemptResponse](#schemapaymentattemptresponse)]|false|none|List of attempts that happened on this intent|
|captures|[[CaptureResponse](#schemacaptureresponse)]|false|none|List of captures done on latest attempt|
|mandate_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** A unique identifier to link the payment to a mandate, can be used instead of payment_method_data, in case of setting up recurring payments|
|mandate_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|setup_future_usage|object \| null|false|none|none|
|off_session|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to true to indicate that the customer is not in your checkout flow during this payment, and therefore is unable to authenticate. This parameter is intended for scenarios where you collect card details and charge them later. This parameter can only be used with confirm=true.|
|capture_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|capture_method_applied|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|Indicates the type of payment method. Eg: 'card', 'wallet', etc.|
|payment_method_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_token|string \| null|false|none|Provide a reference to a stored payment method|
|shipping|object \| null|false|none|none|
|billing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|order_details|[[OrderDetailsWithAmount](#schemaorderdetailswithamount)]|false|none|Information about the product , quantity and amount for connectors. (e.g. Klarna)|
|email|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** description: The customer's email address<br>This field will be deprecated soon. Please refer to `customer.email` object|
|name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** description: The customer's name<br>This field will be deprecated soon. Please refer to `customer.name` object|
|phone|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The customer's phone number<br>This field will be deprecated soon. Please refer to `customer.phone` object|
|return_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL to redirect after the completion of the operation|
|authentication_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|statement_descriptor_name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** For non-card charges, you can use this value as the complete description that appears on your customers’ statements. Must contain at least one letter, maximum 22 characters. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|
|statement_descriptor_suffix|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Provides information about a card payment that customers see on their statements. Concatenated with the prefix (shortened descriptor) or statement descriptor that’s set on the account to form the complete statement descriptor. Maximum 255 characters for the concatenated descriptor. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|

|error_code|string \| null|false|none|The connector-specific error code from the last failed payment attempt associated with this payment intent.|
|error_message|string \| null|false|none|A human-readable error message from the last failed payment attempt associated with this payment intent.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The primary amount for the payment, provided in the lowest denomination of the specified currency (e.g., 6540 for $65.40 USD). This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|order_tax_amount|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Total tax amount applicable to the order, in the lowest denomination of the currency.|
|currency|object \| null|false|none|none|
|amount_to_capture|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The amount to be captured from the user's payment method, in the lowest denomination. If not provided, and `capture_method` is `automatic`, the full payment `amount` will be captured. If `capture_method` is `manual`, this can be specified in the `/capture` call. Must be less than or equal to the authorized amount.|
|shipping_cost|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The shipping cost for the payment. This is required for tax calculation in some regions.|
|payment_id|string \| null|false|none|Optional. A merchant-provided unique identifier for the payment, contains 30 characters long (e.g., "pay_mbabizu24mvu3mela5njyhpit4"). If provided, it ensures idempotency for the payment creation request. If omitted, Hyperswitch generates a unique ID for the payment.|
|merchant_id|string \| null|false|none|This is an identifier for the merchant account. This is inferred from the API key<br>provided during the request|
|routing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector|[[Connector](#schemaconnector)]|false|none|This allows to manually select a connector with which the payment can go through.|
|capture_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|authentication_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|billing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|capture_on|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|A timestamp (ISO 8601 code) that determines when the payment should be captured.<br>Providing this field will automatically set `capture` to true|
|confirm|boolean \| null|false|none|If set to `true`, Hyperswitch attempts to confirm and authorize the payment immediately after creation, provided sufficient payment method details are included. If `false` or omitted (default is `false`), the payment is created with a status such as `requires_payment_method` or `requires_confirmation`, and a separate `POST /payments/{payment_id}/confirm` call is necessary to proceed with authorization.|
|customer|object \| null|false|none|none|
|customer_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The identifier for the customer|
|email|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The customer's email address.<br>This field will be deprecated soon, use the customer object instead|
|name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The customer's name.<br>This field will be deprecated soon, use the customer object instead.|
|phone|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The customer's phone number<br>This field will be deprecated soon, use the customer object instead|
|phone_country_code|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The country code for the customer phone number<br>This field will be deprecated soon, use the customer object instead|
|off_session|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to true to indicate that the customer is not in your checkout flow during this payment, and therefore is unable to authenticate. This parameter is intended for scenarios where you collect card details and charge them later. When making a recurring payment by passing a mandate_id, this parameter is mandatory|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An arbitrary string attached to the payment. Often useful for displaying to users or for your own internal record-keeping.|
|return_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL to redirect the customer to after they complete the payment process or authentication. This is crucial for flows that involve off-site redirection (e.g., 3DS, some bank redirects, wallet payments).|
|setup_future_usage|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_token|string \| null|false|none|As Hyperswitch tokenises the sensitive details about the payments method, it provides the payment_token as a reference to a stored payment method, ensuring that the sensitive details are not exposed in any manner.|
|card_cvc|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** This is used along with the payment_token field while collecting during saved card payments. This field will be deprecated soon, use the payment_method_data.card_token object instead|
|shipping|object \| null|false|none|none|
|statement_descriptor_name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** For non-card charges, you can use this value as the complete description that appears on your customers’ statements. Must contain at least one letter, maximum 22 characters. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|
|statement_descriptor_suffix|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Provides information about a card payment that customers see on their statements. Concatenated with the prefix (shortened descriptor) or statement descriptor that’s set on the account to form the complete statement descriptor. Maximum 22 characters for the concatenated descriptor. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|
|order_details|[[OrderDetailsWithAmount](#schemaorderdetailswithamount)]|false|none|Use this object to capture the details about the different products for which the payment is being made. The sum of amount across different products here should be equal to the overall payment amount|
|client_secret|string \| null|false|none|It's a token used for client side verification.|
