### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the payment. This ensures idempotency for multiple payments<br>that have been done by a single merchant.|
|merchant_id|string|true|none|This is an identifier for the merchant account. This is inferred from the API key<br>provided during the request|
|status|object|true|none|none|
|amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The payment amount. Amount for the payment in lowest denomination of the currency. (i.e) in cents for USD denomination, in paisa for INR denomination etc.,|
|net_amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The payment net amount. net_amount = amount + surcharge_details.surcharge_amount + surcharge_details.tax_amount + shipping_cost + order_tax_amount,<br>If no surcharge_details, shipping_cost, order_tax_amount, net_amount = amount|
|shipping_cost|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The shipping cost for the payment.|
|amount_capturable|integer(int64)|true|none|The amount (in minor units) that can still be captured for this payment. This is relevant when `capture_method` is `manual`. Once fully captured, or if `capture_method` is `automatic` and payment succeeded, this will be 0.|
|amount_received|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The total amount (in minor units) that has been captured for this payment. For `fauxpay` sandbox connector, this might reflect the authorized amount if `status` is `succeeded` even if `capture_method` was `manual`.|
|processor_merchant_id|string|true|none|The identifier for the processor merchant account. In platform-connected setups,<br>this is the connected merchant ID. For standard merchants, this is same as merchant_id.|
|initiator|object \| null|false|none|none|
|sdk_authorization|string \| null|false|none|Token containing encoded information for sdk authorization.|
|payment_method_list|object \| null|false|none|none|
|session_tokens|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector|string \| null|false|none|The name of the payment connector (e.g., 'stripe', 'adyen') that processed or is processing this payment.|
|state_metadata|object \| null|false|none|none|
|client_secret|string \| null|false|none|A secret token unique to this payment intent. It is primarily used by client-side applications (e.g., Hyperswitch SDKs) to authenticate actions like confirming the payment or handling next actions. This secret should be handled carefully and not exposed publicly beyond its intended client-side use.|
|created|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Timestamp indicating when this payment intent was created, in ISO 8601 format.|
|modified_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Timestamp indicating when this payment intent was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.|
|connector_customer_id|string \| null|false|none|A unique identifier for a customer provided by the connector.|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "USD", "EUR") for the payment amount. This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|customer_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The identifier for the customer object. If not provided the customer ID will be autogenerated.<br>This field will be deprecated soon. Please refer to `customer.id`|
|customer|object \| null|false|none|none|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An arbitrary string providing a description for the payment, often useful for display or internal record-keeping.|
|refunds|[[RefundResponse](#schemarefundresponse)]|false|none|An array of refund objects associated with this payment. Empty or null if no refunds have been processed.|
|disputes|[[DisputeResponsePaymentsRetrieve](#schemadisputeresponsepaymentsretrieve)]|false|none|List of disputes that happened on this intent|
|attempts|[[PaymentAttemptResponse](#schemapaymentattemptresponse)]|false|none|List of attempts that happened on this intent|
|captures|[[CaptureResponse](#schemacaptureresponse)]|false|none|List of captures done on latest attempt|
|mandate_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** A unique identifier to link the payment to a mandate, can be used instead of payment_method_data, in case of setting up recurring payments|
|mandate_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|setup_future_usage|object \| null|false|none|none|
|off_session|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to true to indicate that the customer is not in your checkout flow during this payment, and therefore is unable to authenticate. This parameter is intended for scenarios where you collect card details and charge them later. This parameter can only be used with confirm=true.|
|capture_on|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|A timestamp (ISO 8601 code) that determines when the payment should be captured.<br>Providing this field will automatically set `capture` to true|
|capture_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|capture_method_applied|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method|[PaymentMethod](#schemapaymentmethod)|true|none|Indicates the type of payment method. Eg: 'card', 'wallet', etc.|
|payment_method_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_token|string \| null|false|none|Provide a reference to a stored payment method|
|shipping|object \| null|false|none|none|
|billing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|order_details|[[OrderDetailsWithAmount](#schemaorderdetailswithamount)]|false|none|Information about the product , quantity and amount for connectors. (e.g. Klarna)|
|email|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** description: The customer's email address<br>This field will be deprecated soon. Please refer to `customer.email` object|
|name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** description: The customer's name<br>This field will be deprecated soon. Please refer to `customer.name` object|

Concatenated with the prefix (shortened descriptor) or statement descriptor that’s set on the account to form the complete statement descriptor. Maximum 255 characters for the concatenated descriptor. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|

|unified_code|string \| null|false|none|error code unified across the connectors is received here if there was an error while calling connector|
|unified_message|string \| null|false|none|error message unified across the connectors is received here if there was an error while calling connector|
|error_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_experience|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector_label|string \| null|false|none|A label identifying the specific merchant connector account (MCA) used for this payment. This often combines the connector name, business country, and a custom label (e.g., "stripe_US_primary").|
|business_country|object \| null|false|none|none|
|business_label|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The label identifying the specific business unit or profile under which this payment was processed by the merchant. To be deprecated soon. Pass the profile_id instead|
|business_sub_label|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** An optional sub-label for further categorization of the business unit or profile used for this payment. To be deprecated soon. Pass the profile_id instead|

|browser_info|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_channel|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method_id|string \| null|false|none|A unique identifier for the payment method used in this payment. |network_transaction_id|string \| null|false|none|The network transaction ID is a unique identifier for the transaction as recognized by the payment network (e.g., Visa, Mastercard), this ID can be used to reference it for future transactions or recurring payments.<br>Refer `payment_method_tokenization_details` for detailed view of payment method tokenization|
|payment_account_reference|string \| null|false|none|Payment Account Reference (PAR) returned by the connector for the underlying card, used to link tokenized and non-tokenized transactions for the same card.|
|network_transaction_link_id|string \| null|false|none|The Mastercard Transaction Link Identifier (TLID) for this payment. Returned on CITs that set up<br>stored credentials. External-vault merchants should persist this and echo it back on subsequent<br>MIT requests. Mandatory for Mastercard recurring/MIT (no static fallback).|
|payment_method_status|object \| null|false|none|none|
|updated|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Date time at which payment was updated|
|split_payments|object \| null|false|none|none|
|frm_metadata|object \| null|false|none|You can specify up to 50 keys, with key names up to 40 characters long and values up to 500 characters long. FRM Metadata is useful for storing additional, structured information on an object related to FRM.|
|extended_authorization_applied|boolean \| null|false|none|flag that indicates if extended authorization is applied on this payment or not|
|extended_authorization_last_applied_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|date and time at which extended authorization was last applied on this payment|
|request_extended_authorization|boolean \| null|false|none|Optional boolean value to extent authorization period of this payment<br><br>capture method must be manual or manual_multiple|
|capture_before|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|date and time after which this payment cannot be captured|
|merchant_order_reference_id|string \| null|false|none|Merchant's identifier for the payment/invoice. This will be sent to the connector<br>if the connector provides support to accept multiple reference ids.<br>In case the connector supports only one reference id, Hyperswitch's Payment ID will be sent as reference.|
|order_tax_amount|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector_mandate_id|string \| null|false|none|Connector Identifier for the payment method|
|card_discovery|object \| null|false|none|none|
|force_3ds_challenge|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if 3ds challenge is forced|
|force_3ds_challenge_trigger|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if 3ds challenge is triggered|
|issuer_error_code|string \| null|false|none|Error code received from the issuer in case of failed payments|
|issuer_error_message|string \| null|false|none|Error message received from the issuer in case of failed payments|
|is_iframe_redirection_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if the redirection has to open in the iframe|
|whole_connector_response|string \| null|false|none|Contains whole connector response|

<h2 id="tocS_PaymentsRetrieveRequest">PaymentsRetrieveRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapaymentsretrieverequest"></a>
<a id="schema_PaymentsRetrieveRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSpaymentsretrieverequest"></a>
<a id="tocspaymentsretrieverequest"></a>

```json
{
  "resource_id": "string",
  "merchant_id": "string",
  "force_sync": true,
  "param": "string",
  "connector": "string",
  "merchant_connector_details": {
    "creds_identifier": "string",
    "encoded_data": {
      "connector_account_details": {},
      "metadata": {}
    }
  },
  "client_secret": "string",
  "expand_captures": true,
  "expand_attempts": true,
  "all_keys_required": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resource_id|string|true|none|The type of ID (ex: payment intent id, payment attempt id or connector txn id)|
|merchant_id|string \| null|false|none|The identifier for the Merchant Account.|
|force_sync|boolean|true|none|Decider to enable or disable the connector call for retrieve request|
|param|string \| null|false|none|Optional query parameters that might be specific to a connector or flow, passed through during the retrieve operation. Use with caution and refer to specific connector documentation if applicable.|
|connector|string \| null|false|none|Optionally specifies the connector to be used for a 'force_sync' retrieve operation. If provided, Hyperswitch will attempt to sync the payment status from this specific connector.|
|merchant_connector_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|client_secret|string \| null|false|none|This is a token which expires after 15 minutes, used from the client to authenticate and create sessions from the SDK|
|expand_captures|boolean \| null|false|none|If enabled provides list of captures linked to latest attempt|
|expand_attempts|boolean \| null|false|none|If enabled provides list of attempts linked to payment intent|
|all_keys_required|boolean \| null|false|none|If enabled, provides whole connector response|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The primary amount for the payment, provided in the lowest denomination of the specified currency (e.g., 6540 for $65.40 USD). This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|order_tax_amount|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Total tax amount applicable to the order, in the lowest denomination of the currency.|
|currency|object \| null|false|none|none|
|amount_to_capture|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The amount to be captured from the user's payment method, in the lowest denomination. If not provided, and `capture_method` is `automatic`, the full payment `amount` will be captured. If `capture_method` is `manual`, this can be specified in the `/capture` call. Must be less than or equal to the authorized amount.|
|shipping_cost|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|The shipping cost for the payment. This is required for tax calculation in some regions.|
|payment_id|string \| null|false|none|Optional. A merchant-provided unique identifier for the payment, contains 30 characters long (e.g., "pay_mbabizu24mvu3mela5njyhpit4"). If provided, it ensures idempotency for the payment creation request. If omitted, Hyperswitch generates a unique ID for the payment.|
|routing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|connector|[[Connector](#schemaconnector)]|false|none|This allows to manually select a connector with which the payment can go through.|
|capture_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|authentication_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|billing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|confirm|boolean \| null|false|none|If set to `true`, Hyperswitch attempts to confirm and authorize the payment immediately after creation, provided sufficient payment method details are included. If `false` or omitted (default is `false`), the payment is created with a status such as `requires_payment_method` or `requires_confirmation`, and a separate `POST /payments/{payment_id}/confirm` call is necessary to proceed with authorization.|
|customer|object \| null|false|none|none|
|customer_id|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The identifier for the customer|
|off_session|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to true to indicate that the customer is not in your checkout flow during this payment, and therefore is unable to authenticate. This parameter is intended for scenarios where you collect card details and charge them later. When making a recurring payment by passing a mandate_id, this parameter is mandatory|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An arbitrary string attached to the payment. Often useful for displaying to users or for your own internal record-keeping.|
|return_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL to redirect the customer to after they complete the payment process or authentication. This is crucial for flows that involve off-site redirection (e.g., 3DS, some bank redirects, wallet payments).|
|setup_future_usage|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_token|string \| null|false|none|As Hyperswitch tokenises the sensitive details about the payments method, it provides the payment_token as a reference to a stored payment method, ensuring that the sensitive details are not exposed in any manner.|
|shipping|object \| null|false|none|none|
|statement_descriptor_name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** For non-card charges, you can use this value as the complete description that appears on your customers’ statements. Must contain at least one letter, maximum 22 characters. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|
|statement_descriptor_suffix|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Provides information about a card payment that customers see on their statements. Concatenated with the prefix (shortened descriptor) or statement descriptor that’s set on the account to form the complete statement descriptor. Maximum 22 characters for the concatenated descriptor. To be deprecated soon, use billing_descriptor instead.|
|order_details|[[OrderDetailsWithAmount](#schemaorderdetailswithamount)]|false|none|Use this object to capture the details about the different products for which the payment is being made. The sum of amount across different products here should be equal to the overall payment amount|
|mandate_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|customer_acceptance|object \| null|false|none|none|
|browser_info|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_experience|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|merchant_connector_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|allowed_payment_method_types|[[PaymentMethodType](#schemapaymentmethodtype)]|false|none|Use this parameter to restrict the Payment Method Types to show for a given PaymentIntent|
|retry_action|object \| null|false|none|none|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|You can specify up to 50 keys, with key names up to 40 characters long and values up to 500 characters long. Metadata is useful for storing additional, structured information on an object.|
|connector_metadata|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_link|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether to generate the payment link for this payment or not (if applicable)|
|payment_link_config|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_link_config_id|string \| null|false|none|Custom payment link config id set at business profile, send only if business_specific_configs is configured|
|surcharge_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|offer_details|object \| null|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_PayoutCreatePayoutLinkConfig">PayoutCreatePayoutLinkConfig</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->

<a id="tocspayoutcreatepayoutlinkconfig"></a>

```json
{
  "logo": "https://hyperswitch.io/favicon.ico",
  "merchant_name": "Hyperswitch",
  "theme": "#4285F4",
  "payout_link_id": "pm_collect_link_2bdacf398vwzq5n422S1",
  "enabled_payment_methods": "[{\"payment_method\": \"bank_transfer\", \"payment_method_types\": [\"ach\", \"bacs\"]}]",
  "form_layout": {},
  "test_mode": false
}
```

Custom payout link config for the particular payout, if payout link is to be generated.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|logo|string \| null|false|none|Merchant's display logo|
|merchant_name|string \| null|false|none|Custom merchant name for the link|
|theme|string \| null|false|none|Primary color to be used in the form represented in hex format|
|payout_link_id|string \| null|false|none|The unique identifier for the collect link.|
|enabled_payment_methods|[[EnabledPaymentMethod](#schemaenabledpaymentmethod)]|false|none|List of payout methods shown on collect UI|
|form_layout|object \| null|false|none|none|
|test_mode|boolean \| null|false|none|`test_mode` allows for opening payout links without any restrictions. This removes<br>- domain name validations<br>- check for making sure link is accessed within an iframe|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payout_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the payout. This ensures idempotency for multiple payouts<br>that have been done by a single merchant. This field is auto generated and is returned in the API response.|
|merchant_id|string|true|none|This is an identifier for the merchant account. This is inferred from the API key<br>provided during the request|
|merchant_order_reference_id|string \| null|false|none|Your unique identifier for this payout or order. This ID helps you reconcile payouts on your system. If provided, it is passed to the connector if supported.|
|amount|integer(int64)|true|none|The payout amount. Amount for the payout in lowest denomination of the currency. (i.e) in cents for USD denomination, in paisa for INR denomination etc.,|
|currency|[Currency](#schemacurrency)|true|none|The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "USD", "EUR") for the payment amount. This field is mandatory for creating a payment.|
|connector|string \| null|false|none|The connector used for the payout|
|payout_type|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payout_method_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|source_bank_data|object \| null|false|none|none|
|billing|object \| null|false|none|none|
|auto_fulfill|boolean|true|none|Set to true to confirm the payout without review, no further action required|
|customer_id|string|true|none|**Deprecated.** The identifier for the customer object. If not provided the customer ID will be autogenerated. _Deprecated: Use the customer object instead._|
|customer|object \| null|false|none|none|
|client_secret|string|true|none|It's a token used for client side verification.|
|return_url|string|true|none|The URL to redirect after the completion of the operation|
|business_country|[CountryAlpha2](#schemacountryalpha2)|true|none|none|
|business_label|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Business label of the merchant for this payout. _Deprecated: Use profile_id instead._|
|description|string \| null|false|none|A description of the payout|
|billing_descriptor|object \| null|false|none|none|
|entity_type|[PayoutEntityType](#schemapayoutentitytype)|true|none|Type of entity to whom the payout is being carried out to, select from the given list of options|
|recurring|boolean|true|none|Specifies whether or not the payout request is recurring|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|You can specify up to 50 keys, with key names up to 40 characters long and values up to 500 characters long. Metadata is useful for storing additional, structured information on an object.|
|merchant_connector_id|string \| null|false|none|Unique identifier of the merchant connector account|
|status|[PayoutStatus](#schemapayoutstatus)|true|none|none|
|error_message|string \| null|false|none|If there was an error while calling the connector the error message is received here|
|error_code|string \| null|false|none|If there was an error while calling the connectors the code is received here|
|frm_message|object \| null|false|none|none|
|profile_id|string|true|none|The business profile that is associated with this payout|
|created|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Time when the payout was created|
|connector_transaction_id|string \| null|false|none|Underlying processor's payout resource ID|
|connector_eligibility_reference_id|string \| null|false|none|Underlying processor's reference ID for the payout eligibility check|
|priority|object \| null|false|none|none|
|attempts|[[PayoutAttemptResponse](#schemapayoutattemptresponse)]|false|none|List of attempts|
|payout_link|object \| null|false|none|none|
|email|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Customer's email. _Deprecated: Use customer object instead._|
|name|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Customer's name. _Deprecated: Use customer object instead._|
|phone|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Customer's phone. _Deprecated: Use customer object instead._|
|phone_country_code|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** Customer's phone country code. _Deprecated: Use customer object instead._|
|unified_code|string \| null|false|none|(This field is not live yet)<br>Error code unified across the connectors is received here in case of errors while calling the underlying connector|
|unified_message|string \| null|false|none|(This field is not live yet)<br>Error message unified across the connectors is received here in case of errors while calling the underlying connector|
|payout_method_id|string \| null|false|none|Identifier for payout method|

<h2 id="tocS_PayoutRetrieveRequest">PayoutRetrieveRequest</h2>

```json
{
  "payout_id": "187282ab-40ef-47a9-9206-5099ba31e432",
  "force_sync": true,
  "merchant_id": "string",
  "expand_attempts": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payout_id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the payout. This ensures idempotency for multiple payouts<br>that have been done by a single merchant. This field is auto generated and is returned in the API response.|
|force_sync|boolean \| null|false|none|`force_sync` with the connector to get payout details<br>(defaults to false)|
|merchant_id|string \| null|false|none|The identifier for the Merchant Account.|
|expand_attempts|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to true to get the list of attempts along with payout details, no further action required|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|profile_name|string \| null|false|none|The name of profile|
|return_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL to redirect after the completion of the operation|
|enable_payment_response_hash|boolean \| null|false|none|A boolean value to indicate if payment response hash needs to be enabled|
|payment_response_hash_key|string \| null|false|none|Refers to the hash key used for calculating the signature for webhooks and redirect response. If the value is not provided, a value is automatically generated.|
|redirect_to_merchant_with_http_post|boolean \| null|false|none|A boolean value to indicate if redirect to merchant with http post needs to be enabled|
|webhook_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Metadata is useful for storing additional, unstructured information on an object.|
|routing_algorithm|object \| null|false|none|The routing algorithm to be used for routing payments to desired connectors|
|intent_fulfillment_time|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Will be used to determine the time till which your payment will be active once the payment session starts|
|frm_routing_algorithm|object \| null|false|none|The frm routing algorithm to be used for routing payments to desired FRM's|
|payout_routing_algorithm|object \| null|false|none|none|
|applepay_verified_domains|[string]|false|none|Verified Apple Pay domains for a particular profile|
|session_expiry|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Client Secret Default expiry for all payments created under this profile|
|payment_link_config|object \| null|false|none|none|
|authentication_connector_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|use_billing_as_payment_method_billing|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether to use the billing details passed when creating the intent as payment method billing|
|collect_shipping_details_from_wallet_connector|boolean \| null|false|none|A boolean value to indicate if customer shipping details needs to be collected from wallet<br>connector only if it is required field for connector (Eg. Apple Pay, Google Pay etc)|
|collect_billing_details_from_wallet_connector|boolean \| null|false|none|A boolean value to indicate if customer billing details needs to be collected from wallet<br>connector only if it is required field for connector (Eg. Apple Pay, Google Pay etc)|
|always_collect_shipping_details_from_wallet_connector|boolean \| null|false|none|A boolean value to indicate if customer shipping details needs to be collected from wallet<br>connector irrespective of connector required fields (Eg. Apple pay, Google pay etc)|
|always_collect_billing_details_from_wallet_connector|boolean \| null|false|none|A boolean value to indicate if customer billing details needs to be collected from wallet<br>connector irrespective of connector required fields (Eg. Apple pay, Google pay etc)|
|is_connector_agnostic_mit_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if the MIT (merchant initiated transaction) payments can be made connector<br>agnostic, i.e., MITs may be processed through different connector than CIT (customer<br>initiated transaction) based on the routing rules.<br>If set to `false`, MIT will go through the same connector as the CIT.|
|payout_link_config|object \| null|false|none|none|
|outgoing_webhook_custom_http_headers|object \| null|false|none|These key-value pairs are sent as additional custom headers in the outgoing webhook request. It is recommended not to use more than four key-value pairs.|
|tax_connector_id|string \| null|false|none|Merchant Connector id to be stored for tax_calculator connector|
|is_tax_connector_enabled|boolean|false|none|Indicates if tax_calculator connector is enabled or not.<br>If set to `true` tax_connector_id will be checked.|
|is_network_tokenization_enabled|boolean|false|none|Indicates if network tokenization is enabled or not.|
|is_auto_retries_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if is_auto_retries_enabled is enabled or not.|
|max_auto_retries_enabled|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Maximum number of auto retries allowed for a payment|
|always_request_extended_authorization|boolean \| null|false|none|Bool indicating if extended authentication must be requested for all payments|
|is_click_to_pay_enabled|boolean|false|none|Indicates if click to pay is enabled or not.|
|authentication_product_ids|object \| null|false|none|Product authentication ids|
|card_testing_guard_config|object \| null|false|none|none|
|is_clear_pan_retries_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if clear pan retries is enabled or not.|
|force_3ds_challenge|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if 3ds challenge is forced|
|is_debit_routing_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if debit routing is enabled or not|
|merchant_business_country|object \| null|false|none|none|
|is_iframe_redirection_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if the redirection has to open in the iframe|
|is_pre_network_tokenization_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if pre network tokenization is enabled or not|
|merchant_category_code|object \| null|false|none|none|
|merchant_country_code|object \| null|false|none|none|
|dispute_polling_interval|integer(int32) \| null|false|none|Time interval (in hours) for polling the connector to check  for new disputes|
|is_manual_retry_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates if manual retry for payment is enabled or not|
|auto_fallback_capture_method|boolean \| null|false|none|When `true`, a payment whose requested `capture_method` is not supported by the<br>connector chosen for it is processed with `automatic` capture instead of being rejected,<br>and the payment method list does not hide payment methods based on `capture_method`.|
|always_enable_overcapture|boolean \| null|false|none|Bool indicating if overcapture  must be requested for all payments|
|is_external_vault_enabled|object \| null|false|none|none|
|external_vault_connector_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|billing_processor_id|string \| null|false|none|Merchant Connector id to be stored for billing_processor connector|

|network_tokenization_credentials|object \| null|false|none|none|
|payment_method_blocking|object \| null|false|none|none|

This represents the fallback routing connectors configured
at the profile level.

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|connectors|[[RoutableConnectorChoice](#schemaroutableconnectorchoice)]|true|none|List of connectors configured as default for this profile.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>[<br>{<br>"connector": "stripe",<br>"merchant_connector_id": "mca_ExbsYfO1xFErhNtwY1PX"<br>}<br>]<br>```|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|merchant_id|string|true|none|The identifier for Merchant Account|
|profile_id|string|true|none|The identifier for profile. This must be used for creating merchant accounts, payments and payouts|
|profile_name|string|true|none|Name of the profile|
|return_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL to redirect after the completion of the operation|
|enable_payment_response_hash|boolean|true|none|A boolean value to indicate if payment response hash needs to be enabled|
|payment_response_hash_key|string \| null|false|none|Refers to the hash key used for calculating the signature for webhooks and redirect response. If the value is not provided, a value is automatically generated.|
|redirect_to_merchant_with_http_post|boolean|true|none|A boolean value to indicate if redirect to merchant with http post needs to be enabled|
|webhook_details|object \| null|false|none|none|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Metadata is useful for storing additional, unstructured information on an object.|

If this is not passed by the merchant, this field shall be auto generated and provided in the API response. It is recommended to generate uuid(v4) as the refund_id.|
|merchant_id|string \| null|false|none|The identifier for the Merchant Account|
|amount|integer(int64) \| null|false|none|Total amount for which the refund is to be initiated. Amount for the payment in lowest denomination of the currency. (i.e) in cents for USD denomination, in paisa for INR denomination etc., If not provided, this will default to the full payment amount|
|reason|string \| null|false|none|Reason for the refund. Often useful for displaying to users and your customer support executive. In case the payment went through Stripe, this field needs to be passed with one of these enums: `duplicate`, `fraudulent`, or `requested_by_customer`|

|metadata|object \| null|false|none|You can specify up to 50 keys, with key names up to 40 characters long and values up to 500 characters long. Metadata is useful for storing additional, structured information on an object.|

Request payload for resuming a subscription.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resume_option|object \| null|false|none|none|
|resume_date|string \| null|false|none|Optional date when the subscription should be resumed (if not provided, resumes immediately)|

<h2 id="tocS_ResumeSubscriptionResponse">ResumeSubscriptionResponse</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaresumesubscriptionresponse"></a>
<a id="schema_ResumeSubscriptionResponse"></a>
<a id="tocSresumesubscriptionresponse"></a>
<a id="tocsresumesubscriptionresponse"></a>

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "status": "active",
  "merchant_reference_id": "string",
  "profile_id": "string",
  "merchant_id": "string",
  "customer_id": "string",
  "next_billing_at": "string"
}
```

Response payload returned after successfully resuming a subscription.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|[SubscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid)|true|none|A type for subscription_id that can be used for subscription ids|
|status|[SubscriptionStatus](#schemasubscriptionstatus)|true|none|Possible states of a subscription lifecycle.<br><br>- `Created`: Subscription was created but not yet activated.<br>- `Active`: Subscription is currently active.<br>- `InActive`: Subscription is inactive.<br>- `Pending`: Subscription is pending activation.<br>- `Trial`: Subscription is in a trial period.<br>- `Paused`: Subscription is paused.<br>- `Unpaid`: Subscription is unpaid.<br>- `Onetime`: Subscription is a one-time payment.<br>- `Cancelled`: Subscription has been cancelled.<br>- `Failed`: Subscription has failed.|
|merchant_reference_id|string \| null|false|none|Merchant specific Unique identifier.|
|profile_id|[ProfileId](#schemaprofileid)|true|none|A type for profile_id that can be used for business profile ids|
|merchant_id|[MerchantId](#schemamerchantid)|true|none|A type for merchant_id that can be used for merchant ids|
|customer_id|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid)|true|none|A type for customer_id that can be used for customer ids|
|next_billing_at|string \| null|false|none|Date when the subscription was resumed|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|created|
|status|in_active|
|status|pending|
|status|trial|
|status|paused|
|status|unpaid|
|status|onetime|
|status|cancelled|
|status|failed|

<h2 id="tocS_RoutingEvaluateRequest">RoutingEvaluateRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaroutingevaluaterequest"></a>
<a id="schema_RoutingEvaluateRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSroutingevaluaterequest"></a>
<a id="tocsroutingevaluaterequest"></a>

```json
{
  "created_by": "profile_123",
  "payment_id": "pay_abc123",
  "parameters": {},
  "fallback_output": [
    {
      "gateway_name": "absa_sanlam",
      "gateway_id": "authipay_1705"
    }
  ],
  "algorithm_for": {}
}
```

Request body used to evaluate routing rules.

This API evaluates routing logic based on dynamic parameters
like payment method, amount, country, card_bin, etc.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created_by|string|true|none|Identifier of the user/system triggering routing evaluation.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"created_by": "some_id"<br>```|
|payment_id|string \| null|false|none|Payment ID for debugging and tracing routing decisions.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"payment_id": "pay_abc123"<br>```|
|parameters|object|true|none|Dynamic parameters used during routing evaluation.<br><br>Each key represents a routing attribute.<br><br>Example fields:<br><br>- `payment_method`<br>- `payment_method_type`<br>- `amount`<br>- `currency`<br>- `authentication_type`<br>- `card_bin`<br>- `capture_method`<br>- `business_country`<br>- `billing_country`<br>- `business_label`<br>- `setup_future_usage`<br>- `card_network`<br>- `payment_type`<br>- `mandate_type`<br>- `mandate_acceptance_type`<br>- `metadata`<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>{<br>"payment_method": { "type": "enum_variant", "value": "card" },<br>"amount": { "type": "number", "value": 10 },<br>"currency": { "type": "str_value", "value": "INR" },<br>"authentication_type": { "type": "enum_variant", "value": "three_ds" },<br>"card_bin": { "type": "str_value", "value": "424242" },<br>"business_country": { "type": "str_value", "value": "IN" },<br>"setup_future_usage": { "type": "enum_variant", "value": "off_session" },<br>"card_network": { "type": "enum_variant", "value": "visa" },<br>"metadata": {<br>"type": "metadata_variant",<br>"value": { "key": "key1", "value": "value1" }<br>}<br>}<br>```<br><br>For the complete superset of supported routing keys,<br>refer to `routing_configs.keys` in:<br>https://github.com/juspay/decision-engine/blob/main/config/development.toml|
|fallback_output|[[DeRoutableConnectorChoice](#schemaderoutableconnectorchoice)]|true|none|Fallback connectors used if routing rule evaluation fails.<br><br>These connectors will be returned if no rule matches.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>[<br>{<br>"gateway_name": "stripe",<br>"gateway_id": "mca_123"<br>}<br>]<br>```|
|algorithm_for|object \| null|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_RoutingEvaluateResponse">RoutingEvaluateResponse</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaroutingevaluateresponse"></a>
<a id="schema_RoutingEvaluateResponse"></a>
<a id="tocSroutingevaluateresponse"></a>
<a id="tocsroutingevaluateresponse"></a>

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "output": null,
  "evaluated_output": [
    {
      "connector": "absa_sanlam",
      "merchant_connector_id": "string"
    }
  ],
  "eligible_connectors": [
    {
      "connector": "absa_sanlam",
      "merchant_connector_id": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

Response returned after routing evaluation.

Contains:
- Routing status
- Raw output structure (priority / volume_split)
- Final evaluated connectors
- Eligible connectors list

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|string|true|none|Status of routing evaluation.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>"success"<br>```|
|output|object|true|none|Raw routing output returned by routing engine.<br><br>Possible structures:<br><br>1. Volume Split:<br>```json<br>{<br>"type": "volume_split",<br>"splits": [<br>{<br>"connector": { "gateway_name": "adyen", "gateway_id": "mca_124" },<br>"split": 60<br>},<br>{<br>"connector": { "gateway_name": "stripe", "gateway_id": "mca_123" },<br>"split": 40<br>}<br>]<br>}<br>```<br><br>2. Priority:<br>```json<br>{<br>"type": "priority",<br>"connectors": [<br>{ "gateway_name": "stripe", "gateway_id": "mca_123" },<br>{ "gateway_name": "adyen", "gateway_id": "mca_124" }<br>]<br>}<br>```|
|evaluated_output|[[RoutableConnectorChoice](#schemaroutableconnectorchoice)]|true|none|Final connector(s) selected after evaluation.<br><br>Example:<br>```json<br>[<br>{<br>"connector": "stripe",<br>"merchant_connector_id": "mca_123"<br>}<br>]<br>```|
|eligible_connectors|[[RoutableConnectorChoice](#schemaroutableconnectorchoice)]|true|none|none|

```json
  "payment_id": "string",
  "client_secret": "string",
  "session_token": [
    {
      "delayed_session_token": true,
      "connector": "string",
      "sdk_next_action": {
        "next_action": "post_session_tokens",
        "should_block_confirm": true
      },
      "wallet_name": "google_pay"
    }
  ],
  "vault_details": {
    "vault_type": "hyperswitch",
    "vault_data": {
      "sdk_authorization": "string"
    }
  }

```

Wallet session tokens, or the error that prevented them being minted.

Serialized untagged: a success is the whole `PaymentsSessionResponse` object, a failure is
`{ "error": {...} }`.
Gated on `errors` as well as `v1` — see [`crate::payment_methods::PaymentMethodListResult`].

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[PaymentsSessionResponse](#schemapaymentssessionresponse)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|Serializes as `{ "error": { ... } }` — the same envelope the HTTP layer puts around<br>`ErrorResponse`, so this reads identically to the standalone endpoint's error body.|
|error|[GenericErrorResponseOpenApi](#schemagenericerrorresponseopenapi)|true|none|none|

Response payload returned after successfully creating a subscription.

Includes details such as subscription ID, status, plan, merchant, and customer info.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|[SubscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid)|true|none|A type for subscription_id that can be used for subscription ids|
|merchant_reference_id|string \| null|false|none|Merchant specific Unique identifier.|
|status|[SubscriptionStatus](#schemasubscriptionstatus)|true|none|Possible states of a subscription lifecycle.<br><br>- `Created`: Subscription was created but not yet activated.<br>- `Active`: Subscription is currently active.<br>- `InActive`: Subscription is inactive.<br>- `Pending`: Subscription is pending activation.<br>- `Trial`: Subscription is in a trial period.<br>- `Paused`: Subscription is paused.<br>- `Unpaid`: Subscription is unpaid.<br>- `Onetime`: Subscription is a one-time payment.<br>- `Cancelled`: Subscription has been cancelled.<br>- `Failed`: Subscription has failed.|
|plan_id|string \| null|false|none|Identifier for the associated subscription plan.|
|item_price_id|string \| null|false|none|Identifier for the associated item_price_id for the subscription.|
|profile_id|[ProfileId](#schemaprofileid)|true|none|A type for profile_id that can be used for business profile ids|
|client_secret|string \| null|false|none|This is a token which expires after 15 minutes, used from the client to authenticate and create sessions from the SDK|
|merchant_id|[MerchantId](#schemamerchantid)|true|none|A type for merchant_id that can be used for merchant ids|
|coupon_code|string \| null|false|none|Optional coupon code applied to this subscription.|
|customer_id|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid)|true|none|A type for customer_id that can be used for customer ids|
|payment|object \| null|false|none|none|
|invoice|object \| null|false|none|none|

|status|created|
|status|in_active|
|status|pending|
|status|trial|
|status|paused|
|status|unpaid|
|status|onetime|
|status|cancelled|
|status|failed|

<h2 id="tocS_SubscriptionStatus">SubscriptionStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasubscriptionstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_SubscriptionStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSsubscriptionstatus"></a>
<a id="tocssubscriptionstatus"></a>

```json
"active"
```

Possible states of a subscription lifecycle.

- `Created`: Subscription was created but not yet activated.
- `Active`: Subscription is currently active.
- `InActive`: Subscription is inactive.
- `Pending`: Subscription is pending activation.
- `Trial`: Subscription is in a trial period.
- `Paused`: Subscription is paused.
- `Unpaid`: Subscription is unpaid.
- `Onetime`: Subscription is a one-time payment.
- `Cancelled`: Subscription has been cancelled.
- `Failed`: Subscription has failed.

```json
  "card_holder_name": "John Test",
  "card_cvc": "string"
}
```

Card token data carried by the external vault proxy `vault_card_token_data` variant. Its
`card_cvc` is a vault token detokenized on the wire by the external vault (e.g. VGS). Kept as a
distinct type from [`CardToken`] so the self-hosted `card_cvc_token` field does not leak into
the proxy contract.

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|card_holder_name|string|true|none|The card holder's name|
|card_cvc|string \| null|false|none|The CVC number for the card (a vault token for the external vault proxy flow)|

```json
  "vault_type": "hyperswitch",
  "vault_data": {
    "sdk_authorization": "string"
  }
}
```

V1-facing vault details for the session-tokens response, serialized as a tagged
`{ "vault_type": ..., "vault_data": { ... } }` object. Exactly one variant is returned:
external vault details when configured, otherwise the internal Hyperswitch vault session.

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|vault_type|string|true|none|none|
|vault_data|[HyperswitchVaultData](#schemahyperswitchvaultdata)|true|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|vault_type|string|true|none|none|
|vault_data|[VgsVaultData](#schemavgsvaultdata)|true|none|none|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|vault_type|vgs|

```json
}
```

Typed subtype-specific data for a saved customer payment method, returned in the
`GET /payments/{payment_id}/payment-methods/client` response.

Serializes as an externally-tagged enum, producing e.g.:
`{ "card": { "last4_digits": "4242", ... } }`

Only variants for subtypes that actually carry extra data are included;
for all other subtypes the `payment_method_data` field on
`CustomerPaymentMethodForClient` is `None`.
Wallet payment method data returned in the client-facing PM list.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|apple_pay|[PaymentMethodDataWalletInfo](#schemapaymentmethoddatawalletinfo)|true|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|google_pay|[PaymentMethodDataWalletInfo](#schemapaymentmethoddatawalletinfo)|true|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|pay_pal|[PaypalRedirection](#schemapaypalredirection)|true|none|none|

Hyperswitch supports SDK integration with Apple Pay and Google Pay wallets. For other wallets, we integrate with their respective connectors, redirecting the customer to the connector for wallet payments. As a result, we don’t receive any payment method data in the confirm call for payments made through other wallets.

|destination_account_id|string|true|none|ID of the destination account where the amount will be routed to|
|reference_id|string|true|none|Reference ID which acts as an identifier of the route itself|
